flavor: Can smell a drop of vengeance in the water up to a mile away.

name: Hench-Clan Burglar
text: Battlecry: Discover a spell from another class.
flavor: She’s more of a rat burglar.

name: High Priestess Jeklik
text: Taunt, Lifesteal When you discard this, add 2 copies of it to your hand.
flavor: If you love Jeklik, set her free. YOU CAN'T GET RID OF HER.

name: Houndmaster Shaw
text: Your other minions have Rush.
flavor: They’re good dogs, Tess.

name: Lifedrinker
text: Battlecry: Deal 3 damage to the enemy hero. Restore 3 Health to your hero.
flavor: In a pinch, he'll also settle for Holy Water: Zero.

name: Lyra the Sunshard
text: Whenever you cast a spell, add a random Priest spell to your hand.
flavor: Arise, fair sun, and kill my envious foes. They don't have a legendary as beautiful as you.

name: Marked Shot
text: Deal 4 damage to a minion. Discover a spell.
flavor: Obviously it's marked for greatness.

name: Metamorphosis
text: Swap your Hero Power to "Deal 5 damage." After 2 uses, swap it back.
flavor: As the humble caterpillar becomes a beautiful butterfly, so too does a demon hunter become a hideous mass of writhing destruction and unfettered chaos.

name: Nordrassil Druid
text: Battlecry: The next spell you cast this turn costs (3) less.
flavor: The World Tree Nordrassil provides life-giving energy to the world--and excellent mana savings.

name: School Teacher
text: Battlecry: Add a 1/1 Nagaling to your hand. Discover a spell that costs (3) or less to teach it.
flavor: She also tutors 3 Piranha Swarmers on her off hours.

name: Selfish Shellfish
text: Deathrattle: Your opponent draws 2 cards.
flavor: Keeps any ancient book it finds all to its shelf.

name: Spitelash Siren
text: After you play a Naga, refresh two Mana Crystals. (Then switch to spell!)@After you cast a spell, refresh two Mana Crystals. (Then switch to Naga!)
flavor: Refresh the rainbow.

name: Twilight Drake
text: Battlecry: Gain +1 Health for each card in your hand.
flavor: Twilight drakes feed on Mystical Energy. And Tacos.

name: Twinbow Terrorcoil
text: Battlecry: If you've cast a spell while holding this, your next spell casts twice.
flavor: Two shots. Two kills.

name: Warsong Outrider
text: Rush
flavor: When it comes to the Warsong clan, outriders are the insiders.

name: Amber Watcher
text: Battlecry: Restore 8 Health.
flavor: Healing really resin-ates with him.

name: Azsharan Sentinel
text: Taunt. Deathrattle: Put a 'Sunken Sentinel' on the bottom of your deck.
flavor: For some, the Sundering was the collapse of civilization. For others, it was a great core workout.

name: Azsharan Vessel
text: Summon two 3/3 Pirates with Stealth. Put a 'Sunken Vessel' on the bottom of your deck.
flavor: Not even the sturdiest Highborne ship could survive the churning waters of the Sundering.

name: Azure Drake
text: Spell Damage +1 Battlecry: Draw a card.
flavor: They initially planned to be the Beryl or Cerulean drakes, but those felt a tad too pretentious.

name: Bloodlust
text: Give your minions +3 Attack this turn.
flavor: blaarghghLLGHRHARAAHAHHH!!

name: Bone Glaive
text: Battlecry: Dredge.
flavor: Resourceful Demon Hunters find a use for every part of the Demon.

name: Bootstrap Sunkeneer
text: Combo: Put an enemy minion on the bottom of your opponent's deck.
flavor: Part of the deck, part of the crew.

name: Cobalt Scalebane
text: At the end of your turn, give another random friendly minion +3 Attack.
flavor: You get a sword! And you get a sword! Everybody gets a sword!

name: Coral Keeper
text: Battlecry: Summon a 3/3 Elemental for each spell school you've cast this game.
flavor: This here is Carl. They're in charge of these elementals. Not all of them get along, so sometimes Carl corrals the quarreling coral.

name: Darius Crowley
text: Rush After this attacks and kills a minion, gain +2/+2.
flavor: You either die a villain, or live long enough to see yourself become the hero.

name: Flipper Friends
text: Choose One - Summon a 6/6 Orca with Taunt; or six 1/1 Otters with Rush.
flavor: Despite the harsh conditions, friends can still be found under the sea.

name: Gangplank Diver
text: Dormant for 1 turn. Rush. Immune while attacking.
flavor: Cownonball!

name: Gorloc Ravager
text: Battlecry: Draw 3 Murlocs.
flavor: Be careful what you fish for.

name: Ini Stormcoil
text: Battlecry: Choose a friendly Mech. Summon a copy of it with Rush, Windfury, and Divine Shield.
flavor: Before setting her sights on exploration, Ini was known for many inventions, such as the airborne breadmaking dirigible, the hypersprocket 200X zoom binoculars, and jobes (jean robes).

name: Lady Ashvane
text: Battlecry: Give all weapons in your hand, deck, and battlefield +1/+1.
flavor: This is your brain on Azerite.

name: Queen Azshara
text: Battlecry: If you've cast three spells while holding this, choose an Ancient Relic.@ ({0} left!)@ (Ready!)
flavor: Hobbies include: Ordering subjects around, making deals with old gods, and taking long walks under the beach.

name: Switcheroo
text: Draw 2 minions. Swap their Health.
flavor: Would you rather fight one Whale-sized Goldfish, or 100 Goldfish-sized Whales?

name: Za'qul
text: Your Abyssal Curses heal you for the damage they deal. Battlecry: Give your opponent an Abyssal Curse.
flavor: Everything’s going exzaq’ully to plan.

name: Abyssal Wave
text: Deal 4 damage to all minions. Give your opponent an Abyssal Curse.
flavor: Often followed up with a chasmic handshake.

name: Barbaric Sorceress
text: Taunt. Battlecry: Swap the Cost of a random spell in each player's hand.
flavor: Her four arms are for casting, and her forearms are for crushing.

name: Blizzard
text: Deal 2 damage to all enemy minions and Freeze them.
flavor: This spell can be very Entertaining.

name: Blood in the Water
text: Deal 3 damage to an enemy. Summon a 5/5 Shark with Rush.
flavor: Fish are friends, not food! Gilgoblins on the other hand…

name: Coilskar Commander
text: Taunt. Battlecry: If you've cast three spells while holding this, summon two copies of this.@ ({0} left!)@ (Ready!)
flavor: Then thou shalt count to three, no more, no less. Three shall be the number thou shalt count, and the number of the counting shall be three. Four shalt thou not count, neither count thou two, excepting that thou then proceed to three. Five is right out.

name: Crabatoa
text: Colossal +2 Your Crabatoa Claws have +2 Attack.
flavor: This giant crab loves to sink entire naval fleets, but it'll settle for a single dinghy in a pinch.

name: Green-Thumb Gardener
text: Battlecry: Refresh empty Mana Crystals equal to the Cost of the highest Cost spell in your hand.
flavor: Sometimes all a plant needs is, like, A LOT of water.

name: Krag'wa, the Frog
text: Battlecry: Return all spells you played last turn to your hand.
flavor: Krag'wa has a ritual to honor his friends and a ritual to devour his enemies. No one can tell them apart.

name: Lightbomb
text: Deal damage to each minion equal to its Attack.
flavor: This is what happens when you allow goblins to be priests.

name: Mossy Horror
text: Battlecry: Destroy all other minions with 2 or less Attack.
flavor: The hills have eyes. And teeth. Pretty bad breath, too.

name: Reno Jackson
text: Battlecry: If your deck has no duplicates, fully heal your hero.
flavor: Reno is a four-time winner of the 'Best Accessorized Explorer' award.

name: Stormcoil Mothership
text: Rush Deathrattle: Summon two random Mechs that cost (3) or less.
flavor: Has been known to abduct sea cows and leave kelp circles.

name: Swiftscale Trickster
text: Battlecry: Your next spell this turn costs (0).
flavor: If you play your cards fast enough, who's to say how much they cost?

name: Abyssal Enforcer
text: Battlecry: Deal 3 damage to all other characters.
flavor: The Kabal print this on every package of illicit Mana Crystals: WARNING - DO NOT PUT WITHIN REACH OF ABYSSALS. THIS IS NOT APPROVED FOR USE BY FLAMING DEMONS OF ANY KIND.

name: Ancient of Lore
text: Choose One - Draw 2 cards; or Restore 7 Health.
flavor: Go ahead, carve your initials in him.

name: Blackscale Brute
text: Taunt. Battlecry: If you have a weapon equipped, summon a 5/6 Naga with Rush.
flavor: Black, the scales of angry Naga! Red, the flames of Azshari's past!

name: Blackwater Behemoth
text: Colossal +1 Lifesteal
flavor: What's a Blackwater Behemoth's favorite meal? Fish n' Ships.

name: Colaque
text: Colossal +1 Immune while you control Colaque's Shell.
flavor: Ten thousand years ago, the city of Zin-Azshari fell to the bottom of the sea... and partially onto Colaque's shell.

name: Enslaved Fel Lord
text: Taunt. Also damages the minions next to whomever this attacks.
flavor: He's not really chained up. He just wears that to scare the imps when they get too unruly.

name: Flamereaper
text: Also damages the minions next to whomever your hero attacks.
flavor: Honestly it sows more flame than it reaps.

name: Glugg the Gulper
text: Colossal +3 After a friendly minion dies, gain its original stats.
flavor: Food can be scarce in the Abyssal Depths, leading its top predators to pursue any potential source of sustenance. Even extra crunchy ones.

name: Hedra the Heretic
text: Battlecry: For each spell you've cast while holding this, summon a minion of that spell's Cost.
flavor: Hedra was cast out millennia ago for her divisive opinions among the Naga, such as "Turning into evil underwater serpent people was bad, actually."

name: Hydralodon
text: Colossal +2 Battlecry: Give your Hydralodon Heads Rush.
flavor: Deep beneath the waves, this hydra grew to incredible size based on a steady diet of literally anything that crossed its path.

name: Immortalized in Stone
text: Summon a 4/8, 2/4, and 1/2 Elemental with Taunt.
flavor: They all secretly have 'Deathrattle: Become very mortalized.'

name: Miracle Growth
text: Draw 3 cards. Summon a Plant with Taunt and stats equal to your hand size.
flavor: I’ve got NO idea what’s in that fertilizer.

name: Nellie, the Great Thresher
text: Colossal +1 Battlecry: Discover 3 Pirates to crew Nellie's Ship!
flavor: Not to be mistaken for her freshwater cousin, Nessie, this massive creature was harnessed to carry Hooktusk's favorite ship.

name: Pirate Admiral Hooktusk
text: Battlecry: If you've summoned 7 other Pirates this game, plunder the enemy!@ ({0} left!)@ (Ready!)
flavor: You win some, you ransom.

name: Slithering Deathscale
text: Battlecry: If you've cast three spells while holding this, deal 3 damage to all enemies.@ ({0} left!)@ (Ready!)
flavor: Colossal minions know her better as Slithering Damagescale.

name: Tess Greymane
text: Battlecry: Replay every card from another class you've played this game (targets chosen randomly).
flavor: Those who cannot remember their card history are doomed to repeat it.

name: The Leviathan
text: Colossal +1 Rush, Divine Shield After this attacks, Dredge.
flavor: Built by Ini Stormcoil, this massive vessel can withstand almost anything you put it through... although she would prefer you didn't!

name: Wrathspine Enchanter
text: Battlecry: Cast a copy of a Fire, Frost, and Nature spell in your hand (targets chosen randomly).
flavor: If he could see, he might be better at targeting.

name: Xhilag of the Abyss
text: Colossal +4 At the start of your turn, increase the damage of Xhilag's Stalks by 1.
flavor: When ancient heroes drove a felhunter into the sea, they thought it was the end. But for Xhilag, it was only the beginning...

name: Gaia, the Techtonic
text: Colossal +2 After a friendly Mech attacks, deal 1 damage to all enemies.
flavor: Always planning ahead, Ini knew she'd need this invention to protect all her other inventions.

name: Gigafin
text: Colossal +1. Battlecry: Devour all enemy minions. Deathrattle: Spit them back out.
flavor: How much storage does Gigafin's Maw have? About a giga bite.

name: Kalecgos
text: Your first spell each turn costs (0). Battlecry: Discover a spell.
flavor: He was once the Aspect of Magic but gave it up to focus on cheap tricks.

name: Murozond the Infinite
text: Battlecry: Play all cards your opponent played last turn.
flavor: "Well, I'm glad YOU knew what I should be doing this turn."

name: Primordial Drake
text: Taunt Battlecry: Deal 2 damage to all other minions.
flavor: Before he became a rap artist.

name: Ragnaros, Lightlord
text: At the end of your turn, restore 8 Health to a damaged friendly character.
flavor: What happens when you try and corrupt a corrupted firelord? DOUBLE NEGATIVE, INSECT!

name: Whirlpool
text: Destroy all minions and all copies of them (wherever they are).
flavor: In the southern hemisphere, it actually summons all minions instead.

name: Trenchstalker
text: Battlecry: Attack three different random enemies.
flavor: Cooler heads prevail.

name: Pyroblast
text: Deal 10 damage.
flavor: Take the time for an evil laugh after you draw this card.

name: Sea Giant
text: Costs (1) less for each other minion on the battlefield.
flavor: See? Giant.

name: The Garden's Grace
text: Give a minion +4/+4 and Divine Shield. Costs (1) less for each Mana you've spent on Holy spells this game.
flavor: The perfect place to hold Conchella.

name: Naga Giant
text: Costs (1) less for each Mana you've spent on spells this game.
flavor: He might be giant, but he’s still a couple thousand protein shakes away from competing in the Colossal Wrestling Championship.

name: Bubbler
text: After this minion takes exactly one damage, destroy it. (Pop!)
flavor: Prefers regular over diet shampoo.

name: Moonbeam
text: Deal 1 damage to an enemy, twice.
flavor: The light of the moon may have disappeared from Zin-Azshari after the Sundering, but not its power.

name: Shattershambler
text: Battlecry: Your next Deathrattle minion costs (1) less, but immediately dies when played.
flavor: Someone didn’t realize the ‘cold, black heart’ thing was supposed to be a metaphor.

name: Fossil Fanatic
text: After your hero attacks, draw a Fel spell.
flavor: Praise Lord Helix!

name: Inkveil Ambusher
text: Stealth Has +3 Attack and Immune while attacking.
flavor: You’ve got it wrong. She releases ink when you’re scared.

name: Jackpot!
text: Add two random spells from other classes that cost (5) or more to your hand.
flavor: Find someone who looks at you the way Hooktusk looks at loot.

name: K9-0tron
text: Battlecry: Dredge. If it's a 1-Cost minion, summon it.
flavor: You merely adopted the Battlegrounds. I was born in it. Molded by it.

name: Spirit of the Tides
text: If you have any unspent Mana at the end of your turn, gain +1/+2.
flavor: Cleans the ocean better than any store-brand competitor - guaranteed or your Mana back!

name: Submerged Spacerock
text: Deathrattle: Add two Arcane Mage spells to your hand. They are Temporary.
flavor: Time for some out of this world RNG.

name: Ancient Krakenbane
text: Battlecry: If you've cast three spells while holding this, deal 5 damage.@ ({0} left!)@ (Ready!)
flavor: "Call me Fishmael."

name: Clash of the Colossals
text: Add a random Colossal minion to both players' hands. Yours costs (2) less.
flavor: Don’t let this distract you from the fact that in 1998, Ozumat threw Neptulon off Shell in a Cell, and plummeted 16 fathoms through an announcer’s table.

name: Clownfish
text: Battlecry: Your next two Murlocs cost (2) less.
flavor: His jokes are hilarious if you know Nerglish.

name: Herald of Chaos
text: Lifesteal Battlecry: If you've cast a Fel spell while holding this, gain Rush.
flavor: They used to be called the Heralds of Order before all of this silly Sundering nonsense.

name: Herald of Light
text: Battlecry: If you've cast a Holy spell while holding this, restore 6 Health to all friendly characters.
flavor: Wake up! No sleeping in with the fishes!

name: Herald of Nature
text: Battlecry: If you've cast a Nature spell while holding this, give your other minions +1/+1.
flavor: A mother of plants in mother of pearl.

name: Herald of Shadows
text: Battlecry: If you've cast a Shadow spell while holding this, steal 2 Health from a minion.
flavor: “IT’S NOT A PHASE, MOM!”

name: Myrmidon
text: After you cast a spell on this minion, draw a card.
flavor: He didn't have time to Myrmidon the other half of his armor before combat started.

name: Polymorph: Jellyfish
text: Transform a minion into a 4/1 Jellyfish with Spell Damage +2.
flavor: While Ini’s first use of the Spontaneous Gelatin Transmalgamizer may have gotten her banned from the Gnomish Cooking Convention, she’s never one to throw away a new invention.

name: Shellshot
text: Deal 3 damage to a random enemy minion. Repeat this with 1 less damage.
flavor: Precision over accuracy.

name: Snapdragon
text: Battlecry: Give all Battlecry minions in your deck +1/+1.
flavor: Good synergy with Crackledragon, not so much with Popdragon.

name: Coilfang Constrictor
text: Battlecry: Look at 3 cards in your opponent's hand and choose one. It can't be played next turn.
flavor: How do you know when someone has a crush on you? They take your breath away.

name: Disarming Elemental
text: Battlecry: Dredge for your opponent. Set its Cost to (6).
flavor: "You can have these back when you learn to play nice."

name: Drown
text: Put an enemy minion on the bottom of your deck.
flavor: If you play it on a Naga, they drown in their sorrows instead.

name: Igneous Lavagorger
text: Taunt Battlecry: Dredge. Gain Armor equal to its Cost.
flavor: Lava shark, doo doo doo doo doo doo.

name: Immolate
text: Light every card in the opponent's hand on fire. In 3 turns, any still in hand are destroyed!
flavor: "Well if you cared about those cards so much, why didn't you play them?"

name: Tidelost Burrower
text: Battlecry: Dredge. If it's a Murloc, summon a 2/2 copy of it.
flavor: Burrowing may not be for everyone, but I dig it.

name: Topple the Idol
text: Dredge. Reveal it and deal damage equal to its Cost to all minions.
flavor: No Old Gods or Kings, only Naga.

name: Command of Neptulon
text: Summon two 5/4 Elementals with Rush. Overload: (1)
flavor: "REVENANT TO F6. CHECKMATE, OZUMAT!"

name: Commander Ulthok
text: Battlecry: Your opponent's cards cost Health instead of Mana next turn.
flavor: He likes to spend his free time in his garden, growing Bloodradish, Bloodcabbage, and his favorite, Bloodbloom.

name: Lady Naz'jar
text: While in your hand, this transforms after you cast a Fire, Frost, or Arcane spell.
flavor: Talk about an identity crisis.

name: Ozumat
text: Colossal +6 Deathrattle: For each of Ozumat's Tentacles, destroy a random enemy minion.
flavor: Deathrattle: You'll be octo-sorry.

name: Tidal Revenant
text: Battlecry: Deal 5 damage. Gain 8 Armor.
flavor: A big minion that clears the board and gains Armor? Wow, Warrior is really in their element now.

name: Front Lines
text: Summon a minion from each player's deck. Repeat until either side of the battlefield is full.
flavor: With the line in the sand crossed, the battle for the Throne of Tides had begun.

name: Lightray
text: Taunt Costs (1) less for each Paladin card you've played this game.
flavor: Lightrays, much like rays of light, tend to be seen closer to the surface.

name: Neptulon the Tidehunter
text: Colossal +2, Rush, Windfury Whenever Neptulon attacks, if you control any Hands, they attack instead.
flavor: Neptulon, tired of filling hands, is now throwing hands.

name: Prince Renathal
text: Your deck size and starting Health are 40.
flavor: A lot of kids go through a rebellious phase, but Prince Renathal's was a bit extreme.

name: Dispose of Evidence
text: Give your hero +3 Attack this turn. Pick from 3 cards in your hand to shuffle into your deck.
flavor: Just because you did it doesn't mean you have to be guilty.

name: Batty Guest
text: Deathrattle: Summon a 2/1 Bat.
flavor: His favorite food is chocolate cereal.

name: Convincing Disguise
text: Transform a friendly minion into one that costs (2) more. Infuse (@): Transform all friendly minions instead.
flavor: Okay gang, let's see who's really under the mask… *gasp* Old Man Bru'kan!?

name: Door of Shadows
text: Draw a spell. Infuse (@): Add a Temporary copy of it to your hand.
flavor: Upon arrival, please ring the doorbell of shadows, and wipe your shoes on the doormat of shadows before entering.

name: Dredger Staff
text: Battlecry: Give minions in your hand +1 Health.
flavor: The dredger staff held the dredger knife and said, "Dredger bow before the Sire!"

name: Flustered Librarian
text: Has +1 Attack for each Imp you control.
flavor: A fairly sIMPle card.

name: Muck Pools
text: Transform a friendly minion into one that costs (1) more.
flavor: Making a dredger is easier than you'd think. You don't need to worry about mucking it up!

name: Planted Evidence
text: Discover a spell. It costs (2) less this turn.
flavor: So you're telling me this wasn't Natural Causes?

name: Promotion
text: Give a Silver Hand Recruit +3/+3 and Taunt.
flavor: And with the new title of 'Golden Hand Recruit', you also get a pay raise!

name: Relic of Extinction
text: Deal @ damage to a random enemy minion, twice. Improve your future Relics.
flavor: Faster than an asteroid, and just as effective.

name: Sanguine Depths
text: Deal 1 damage to a minion and give it +2 Attack.
flavor: There may not be any skeletons in the closets at Castle Nathria, but there sure are souls in the basement.

name: Sinful Sous Chef
text: Deathrattle: Add 2 Silver Hand Recruits to your hand.
flavor: If this dinner party goes well, she thinks she has a good shot at being on Fel's Kitchen.

name: Sinstone Totem
text: At the end of your turn, gain +1 Health.
flavor: This one's heavier than the wooden totems. Mostly from the weight of your sins.

name: Suspicious Alchemist
text: Battlecry: Discover a spell. If your opponent guesses your choice, they get a copy.
flavor: Side effects may include feeling totally fine! Don't even worry about it.

name: Suspicious Usher
text: Battlecry: Discover a Legendary minion. If your opponent guesses your choice, they get a copy.
flavor: "Oh please, let me take your jacket, luggage, and absurdly large shoulder pads."

name: The Light! It Burns!
text: Deal damage to a minion equal to its Attack.
flavor: Wait, if you're over there, then who's messing with the lights?!

name: Anima Extractor
text: Whenever a friendly minion takes damage, give a random minion in your hand +1/+1.
flavor: After we are done you're welcome to help yourself to cookies and apple juice. Thank you for your donation!

name: Anonymous Informant
text: Battlecry: The next Secret you play costs (0).
flavor: It turns out she wasn't so great at keeping secrets after all.

name: Bibliomite
text: Battlecry: Choose a card in your hand to shuffle into your deck.
flavor: He did NOT want to cast a spell.

name: Carving Chisel
text: After your hero attacks, summon a random basic Totem.
flavor: Look at your stone. Visualize the totem within. Then gently...

name: Castle Kennels
text: Give a friendly minion +2 Attack. If it's a Beast, give it Rush.
flavor: Play dead! Oh…

name: Conqueror's Banner
text: Reveal a card from each player's deck, three times. Draw any of yours that cost more.
flavor: Olgra, I love your new tapestry! Where did you get it?

name: Crazed Wretch
text: Has +2 Attack and Charge while damaged.
flavor: Enrage is all the rage.

name: Crooked Cook
text: At the end of your turn, if you dealt 3 or more damage to the enemy hero, draw a card.
flavor: There are many things not called poison which can kill a man. But in this case, it is poison.

name: Double Cross
text: Secret: When your opponent spends all their Mana, draw two cards.
flavor: Valeera revealed herself to be a double agent. At which point Maiev felt comfortable revealing that she also was a double agent. And then Scabbs announced to everybody that - get this - he was a double agent.

name: Frenzied Fangs
text: Summon two 2/1 Bats. Infuse (@): Give them +1/+2.
flavor: That's one stylish bat.

name: Frozen Touch
text: Deal 3 damage. Infuse (@): Add a Frozen Touch to your hand.
flavor: Is this what Bob was talking about when he said he served a drink to a Death Knight once?

name: Great Hall
text: Set a minion's Attack and Health to 3.
flavor: It's fabulous! It's grand! It's, well it's really very nice.

name: Impending Catastrophe
text: Draw a card. Repeat for each Imp you control.
flavor: The imps end you, and the cats... well, they astrophe.

name: Kidnap
text: Secret: After your opponent plays a minion, stuff it in a 0/4 Sack.
flavor: Check your coat, but don't check the coat closet.

name: Maze Guide
text: Battlecry: Summon a random 2-Cost minion.
flavor: "And if you look to your left, you'll see an even larger statue of Sire Denathrius!"

name: Mysterious Visitor
text: Battlecry: Reduce the Cost of cards copied from your opponent by (3).
flavor: Dave, we can tell this letter is fake - it's in your handwriting. And take off that stupid hood, you're embarrassing us.

name: Natural Causes
text: Deal 2 damage. Summon a 2/2 Treant.
flavor: What if the suspect was framed? What if the murder weapon was... a plant?

name: Priest of the Deceased
text: Taunt Infuse (@): Gain +2/+2.
flavor: "Funnel cakes? I haven't had those in years…"

name: Relic Vault
text: The next Relic you play this turn casts twice.
flavor: Holds Sire Denathrius' most prized possession - his teddy bear, Jeremy Bearimy.

name: Riot!
text: Your minions can't be reduced below 1 Health this turn. They each attack a random enemy minion.
flavor: No, Blizzard!

name: Roosting Gargoyle
text: Battlecry: Give a friendly Beast +2 Attack.
flavor: Jalapeñas!

name: Serrated Bone Spike
text: Deal 3 damage to a minion. If it dies, your next card this turn costs (2) less.
flavor: Draka, in an attempt to help, threw them a bone.

name: Sinful Brand
text: Brand an enemy minion. Whenever it takes damage, deal 1 damage to the enemy hero.
flavor: My brand!

name: Sketchy Stranger
text: Battlecry: Discover a Secret from another class.
flavor: More of a 'Painted Stranger' if you ask me.

name: Spirit Poacher
text: Battlecry: Summon a random Dormant Wildseed.
flavor: Always poach from your local spirit shelter.

name: Sticky Situation
text: Secret: After your opponent casts a spell, summon a 3/4 Spider with Stealth.
flavor: "Now this is what I'd call..." "...just shut up."

name: Vile Library
text: Give a friendly minion +1/+1. Repeat for each Imp you control.
flavor: What type of vial library has 0 vials in it!?

name: Volatile Skeleton
text: Deathrattle: Deal 2 damage to a random enemy.
flavor: These ice sculpures look so realistic!

name: Ashen Elemental
text: Battlecry: Whenever your opponent draws a card next turn, they take 2 damage.
flavor: "The castle was nice but the fireplaces were too small - 2/5 stars"

name: Cathedral of Atonement
text: Give a minion +2/+1 and draw a card.
flavor: You'll actually find more than one tonement here.

name: Creepy Painting
text: After another minion dies, become a copy of it.
flavor: I do not like this painting, Harth. Its smug aura mocks me.

name: Demolition Renovator
text: Tradeable Battlecry: Destroy an enemy location.
flavor: "Look, the Sire said he wanted something more open concept..."

name: Dinner Performer
text: Battlecry: Summon a random minion from your deck that you can afford to play.
flavor: BANG!

name: Forensic Duster
text: Battlecry: Your opponent's minions cost (1) more next turn.
flavor: He had plenty of experience with dusting things from his time as a butler, so when a murder was committed he saw a real job opportunity!

name: Ghastly Gravedigger
text: Battlecry: If you control a Secret, choose a card in your opponent's hand to shuffle into their deck.
flavor: Some people take their secrets to the grave.

name: Hedge Maze
text: Trigger a friendly minion's Deathrattle.
flavor: If you keep seeing a statue of the Sire, you’re not going in circles. There’s just so many of them.

name: Identity Theft
text: Discover a copy of a card from your opponent's hand and deck.
flavor: Identity theft is not a joke, Jim!

name: Imbued Axe
text: After your hero attacks, give your damaged minions +1/+2. Infuse (@): +2/+2 instead.
flavor: Technically it's a Yet-to-be-Imbued Axe.

name: Invitation Courier
text: After a card is added to your hand from another class, copy it.
flavor: Sending mail via steward is soooo old school.

name: Magnifying Glaive
text: After your hero attacks, draw until you have 3 cards.
flavor: Vengeance!

name: Muckborn Servant
text: Taunt Battlecry: Discover a Paladin card.
flavor: Party guests never tip as well as the patrons in Bob's tavern.

name: Murloc Holmes
text: Battlecry: Solve 3 Clues about your opponent's cards to get copies of them.
flavor: When you have eliminated the imfroggable, whatever remains, however uncroakable, must be the truth.

name: Nightcloak Sanctum
text: Freeze a minion. Summon a 2/2 Volatile Skeleton.
flavor: For VIPs only. (Very Infused Person)

name: Party Favor Totem
text: At the end of your turn, summon a random basic Totem. Infuse (@): Summon two instead.
flavor: It's the gift (totem) that keeps on giving (totems)!

name: Pelagos
text: After you cast a spell on a friendly minion, set its Attack and Health to the higher of the two.
flavor: He's a great judge of character.

name: Plot of Sin
text: Summon two 2/2 Treants. Infuse (@): Two 5/5 Ancients instead.
flavor: It's a great plot, but it's riddled with holes.

name: Primordial Wave
text: Transform enemy minions into ones that cost (1) less and friendly minions into ones that cost (1) more.
flavor: A primordial hello to you too!

name: Relic of Phantasms
text: Summon two @/@ Spirits. Improve your future Relics.
flavor: Xy'mox chuckled. "You mean the Chaos Emerald?"

name: Service Bell
text: Discover a Class card from your deck and draw all copies of it.
flavor: The bell tolls for us! Waiter, we need more water!

name: Shadowborn
text: Deathrattle: Reduce the Cost of the highest Cost Shadow spell in your hand by (3).
flavor: You merely adopted the shadows; I was born in them!

name: Sinstone Graveyard
text: Summon a @/@ Ghost. (Has +1/+1 for each other card you played this turn!)
flavor: A graveyard in the realm of the dead; a bit redundant, don't you think?

name: Solid Alibi
text: Until your next turn, your hero can only take 1 damage at a time.
flavor: That pillow knows too much…

name: Stag Charge
text: Deal 3 damage. Summon a random Dormant Wildseed.
flavor: Stag! You’re it!

name: Stewart the Steward
text: Deathrattle: Give the next Silver Hand Recruit you summon +3/+3 and this Deathrattle.
flavor: How many bites does it take to get the center of an hors d'oeuvre?

name: Suffocating Shadows
text: When you play or discard this, destroy a random enemy minion.
flavor: "Reading is good for you," they said.

name: Suspicious Pirate
text: Battlecry: Discover a weapon. If your opponent guesses your choice, they get a copy.
flavor: EVERY party should be a costume party.

name: The Harvester of Envy
text: After you play a card copied from the opponent, steal the original.
flavor: "Ah, permission shmermission! You can borrow anything you want, anytime, as long as if you give it back before it's missed. Everyone knows that! Right?"

name: Vengeful Visage
text: Secret: After an enemy minion attacks your hero, summon a copy of it to attack the enemy hero.
flavor: The mirror shows us nothing less than the deepest, darkest desire of our hearts: to go face.

name: Wild Spirits
text: Summon two different Dormant Wildseeds. Make your Wildseeds awaken 1 turn sooner.
flavor: Wait, this card just released! It should be Standard Spirits!

name: Baroness Vashj
text: If this would transform into a minion, summon that minion instead.
flavor: Vashj was supposed to make an appearance in "The Sunken City," but after a freak accident in "Ashes of Outland," she ended up here.

name: Boon of the Ascended
text: Give a minion +2 Health. Summon a Kyrian with its stats and Taunt.
flavor: Ascension is not some external power granted to you, it is the power you find within yourself.

name: Buffet Biggun
text: Battlecry: Summon two Silver Hand Recruits. Infuse (@): Give them +2 Attack and Divine Shield.
flavor: "Look, I just want to know what kind of monster put raisins in this."

name: Burden of Pride
text: Summon three 1/3 Jailers with Taunt. If you have 20 or less Health, give them +1/+1.
flavor: A group of burdens is called a pride.

name: Chatty Bartender
text: At the end of your turn, if you control a Secret, deal 2 damage to all enemies.
flavor: "So a Venthyr, an Old God, and a Tauren walk into a bar…"

name: Cold Case
text: Summon two 2/2 Volatile Skeletons. Gain 4 Armor.
flavor: And that's why you keep your skeletons in your closet instead of your freezer.

name: Crud Caretaker
text: Battlecry: Summon a 3/5 Elemental with Taunt.
flavor: All it takes is a little love and a LOT of junk!

name: Dispossessed Soul
text: Battlecry: If you control a location, Discover a copy of a card in your deck.
flavor: I'm afraid it came as a great shock to her when she died.

name: Halkias
text: Stealth. Deathrattle: Store Halkias's soul inside of a friendly Secret. It resummons Halkias when triggered.
flavor: Everybody tough until the sinstones start walking.

name: Kryxis the Voracious
text: Battlecry: Discard your hand. Deathrattle: Draw 3 cards.
flavor: Tried intermittent fasting. It didn't stick.

name: Mischievous Imp
text: Battlecry: Summon a copy of this. Infuse (@): Summon two copies instead.
flavor: Why is it when something happens, it is always you three?

name: Murlocula
text: Lifesteal Infuse (@): This costs (0).
flavor: The best part of Murlocula is when he said "IT'S MRRGLIN' TIME" and totally mrrgled those guys.

name: Orion, Mansion Manager
text: After a friendly Secret is revealed, cast a different Mage Secret and gain +2/+2.
flavor: The secrets of the universe are vast... and will be revealed sometime later this game.

name: Partner in Crime
text: Battlecry: Summon a copy of this minion at the end of your turn.
flavor: "You know what we need? Some rope." "That's stupid. Name one thing you'd need a rope for."

name: Private Eye
text: Battlecry: Cast a Secret from your deck. Combo: Cast 2 instead.
flavor: Eye see what you did there.

name: Scuttlebutt Ghoul
text: Taunt Battlecry: If you control a Secret, summon a copy of this.
flavor: No 'if's, 'and's, or 'scuttlebutt's'!

name: Stonebound Gargon
text: Rush Infuse (@): Also damages the minions next to whomever this attacks.
flavor: Really good at "stay."

name: The Stonewright
text: Battlecry: For the rest of the game, your Totems have +2 Attack.
flavor: She wrights stone better than she reads it.

name: Widowbloom Seedsman
text: Battlecry: Draw a Nature spell. Gain an empty Mana Crystal.
flavor: Sometimes a blue thumb is better than a green one.

name: Ara'lon
text: Battlecry: Summon one of each Dormant Wildseed.
flavor: If I had a nickel for every time a Hunter Legendary minion in Castle Nathria summoned three different companions, I'd have two nickels - which isn't a lot, but it's weird that it happened twice.

name: Clean the Scene
text: Destroy all minions with 3 or less Attack. Infuse (@): 6 or less.
flavor: Not even the holy Light can get anima out of white silk.

name: Death Blossom Whomper
text: Battlecry: Draw a Deathrattle minion and gain its Deathrattle.
flavor: We call her Audrey II. She was named after her mother.

name: Elitist Snob
text: Battlecry: For each Paladin card in your hand, randomly gain Divine Shield, Lifesteal, Rush, or Taunt.
flavor: "I heard the Sire invited a Murloc! How dreadful!"

name: Famished Fool
text: Battlecry: Draw a card. Infuse (@): Draw 3 instead.
flavor: He's not hungry for food, he's starving for attention!

name: Lady Darkvein
text: Battlecry: Summon two 2/1 Shades. Each gains a Deathrattle to cast your last Shadow spell.
flavor: You're so vein. I bet you think this flavor text is about you.

name: Muck Plumber
text: ALL minions cost (2) more.
flavor: If you drink muck, you go to the Maw before you die.

name: Necrolord Draka
text: Battlecry: Equip a @/3 Dagger. (+1 Attack for each other card you played this turn, up to 10!)
flavor: We originally planned on giving Rogue a Legendary minion called "The Moon", but SOMEONE jumped in the frame.

name: Relic of Dimensions
text: Draw two cards and reduce their Cost by (@). Improve your future Relics.
flavor: A glaive is a glaive, but a mystery box could be anything! It could even be a glaive!

name: Shadow Waltz
text: Summon a 3/5 Shadow with Taunt. If a minion died this turn, summon another.
flavor: They're dancing to one of Rin's demonic symphonies. Her music might not be famous now, but just you wait!

name: Sinrunner
text: Deathrattle: Destroy a random enemy minion.
flavor: Blanchy was said to be an affectionate and well-behaved horse in life. How she ended up in Revendreth? We're too afraid to ask.

name: Steamcleaner
text: Battlecry: Destroy ALL cards in both players' decks that didn't start there.
flavor: Business is slow since the anima shortage began. Things just don't get stained like they used to!

name: Stoneborn Accuser
text: Infuse (@): Gain "Battlecry: Deal 5 damage."
flavor: "I SAW THEM VENT, I SWEAR!"

name: Bog Beast
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Summon a 2/4 Muckmare with Taunt.
flavor: I'm sure at least one of those bones is from an actual beast.

name: Deathborne
text: Deal 2 damage to all minions. Summon a 2/2 Volatile Skeleton for each killed.
flavor: Kel'Thuzad thinks adding a silent 'e' at the end of words makes them sound cooler.

name: Decimator Olgra
text: Battlecry: Gain +1/+1 for each damaged minion, then attack all enemies.
flavor: FOUND HER!

name: Imp King Rafaam
text: Battlecry: Resurrect four friendly Imps. Infuse (@): Give your Imps +2/+2.
flavor: Not even death can stop Rafaam from pursuing a life of crime.

name: Masked Reveler
text: Rush Deathrattle: Summon a 2/2 copy of another minion in your deck.
flavor: "It's party time! P-A-R-T-Why? Because I gotta!"

name: Theotar, the Mad Duke
text: Battlecry: Discover a card in each player's hand and swap them.
flavor: "I'm afraid you've gone mad! You're entirely bonkers. But I'll tell you a secret. All the best souls are."

name: Tome Tampering
text: Shuffle 1-Cost copies of cards in your hand into your deck, then discard your hand.
flavor: An overdue book calls for a do-over.

name: Divine Toll
text: Shoot 5 rays at random minions. They give friendly minions +2/+2, and deal 2 damage to enemy minions.
flavor: Never send to know for whom the bell tolls.

name: Huntsman Altimor
text: Battlecry: Summon a Gargon Companion. Infuse ({0}): Summon another. Infuse ({1}): And another!
flavor: He loves all his Gargons equally. (Hecutis is his favorite and it's not close.)

name: Red Herring
text: Taunt Your non-Red Herring minions have Stealth.
flavor: He's got gill-ty written all over him!

name: Remornia, Living Blade
text: Rush After this attacks, equip it.
flavor: Was it the lead pipe... the candlestick... or the unhinged, sentient, bloodthirsty sword?

name: Sinfueled Golem
text: Infuse (@): Gain stats equal to the Attack of the minions that Infused this.
flavor: That poor golem is going to be stuck as a guard forever. He can never get a head!

name: The Countess
text: Battlecry: If your deck has no Neutral cards, add 3 Legendary Invitations to your hand.
flavor: 3 Legendary Invitations, AH AH AH!

name: Topior the Shrubbagazzor
text: Battlecry: For the rest of the game, after you cast a Nature spell, summon a 3/3 Whelp with Rush.
flavor: They got a dragon that burns 1000 gallons of anima a week.

name: Artificer Xy'mox
text: Battlecry: Discover and cast a Relic. Infuse (@): Cast all three instead.
flavor: "The anticipation to use this relic is killing me! Though, it will more likely kill you."

name: Collateral Damage
text: Deal 6 damage to three random enemy minions. Excess damage hits the enemy hero.

name: Criminal Lineup
text: Choose a friendly minion. Summon 3 copies of it. Overload: (2)
flavor: Number 1, could you please sing the opening to "I Want It That Way"?

name: Kael'thas Sinstrider
text: Every third minion you play each turn costs (0).
flavor: You heard about Kael'thas? That's messed up, right?

name: Kel'Thuzad, the Inevitable
text: Battlecry: Resurrect your Volatile Skeletons. Any that can't fit on the battlefield instantly explode! @(@)
flavor: Looks like Kel'Thuzad is borrowing some of Mr. Bigglesworth's nine lives.

name: Nightshade Bud
text: Choose One - Discover a minion from your deck to summon; or a spell to cast.
flavor: It actually thrives in partial sunlight.

name: Party Crasher
text: Battlecry: Choose an enemy minion. Throw a random minion from your hand at it.
flavor: "Do you ever wonder why you don't get invited anywhere?" "… no, not really."

name: Sesselie of the Fae Court
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Draw a minion. Reduce its Cost by (8).
flavor: They claim they're from the Fae Court, but that might be a Fae Kout.

name: Insatiable Devourer
text: Battlecry: Devour an enemy minion and gain its stats. Infuse (@): And its neighbors.
flavor: You're not you when you're anima-starved.

name: Convoke the Spirits
text: Cast 8 random Druid spells (targets chosen randomly).
flavor: The spirits prefer to convoke when there's some hot gossip to discuss.

name: Gigantotem
text: Costs (1) less for each Totem you've summoned this game.
flavor: Totem Golem's uncle, gone too soon.

name: Sire Denathrius
text: Lifesteal. Battlecry: Deal 5 damage amongst enemies. Endlessly Infuse (@): Deal 1 more.
flavor: History has a way of altering villains so that we can no longer see ourselves in them. Unfortunately for the Venthyr, they all look like Sire Denathrius.

name: Stoneborn General
text: Rush Deathrattle: Summon an 8/8 Gravewing with Rush.
flavor: Leads with an iron fist and a stony demeanor.

name: Call to the Stand
text: Your opponent summons a random minion from their hand.
flavor: Don't worry, there is a chair for you to sit in. It's very misleading.

name: Theft Accusation
text: Choose a minion. Destroy it after you play a card copied from the opponent.
flavor: Honey, where are my paaaaaaants?

name: Totemic Evidence
text: Choose a basic Totem and summon it. Infuse (@ Totems): Summon all 4 instead.
flavor: Every totem is evidence of a tree's murder.

name: Arson Accusation
text: Choose a minion. Destroy it after your hero takes damage.
flavor: We didn't start the fire!

name: Attorney-at-Maw
text: Choose One - Silence a minion; or Give a minion Immune this turn.
flavor: When the going gets tough, you don't want a criminal lawyer... you want a criminal lawyer...

name: Class Action Lawyer
text: Battlecry: If your deck has no Neutral cards, set a minion's stats to 1/1.
flavor: "Have you or a loved one ever been injured in a Consecration?"

name: Imp-oster
text: Battlecry: Choose a friendly Imp. Transform into a copy of it.
flavor: There is an imposter among us.

name: Motion Denied
text: Secret: After your opponent plays three cards in a turn, deal 6 damage to the enemy hero.
flavor: DO NOT PASS GO. DO NOT COLLECT 200 GOLD.

name: Murder Accusation
text: Choose a minion. Destroy it after another enemy minion dies.
flavor: Quote From Man Murdered: "What are you gonna do, murder me?"

name: Perjury
text: Secret: When your turn starts, Discover and cast a Secret from another class.
flavor: By Liar be Perjured!

name: Afterlife Attendant
text: Your Infuse cards also Infuse while in your deck.
flavor: AH! Wrist cramp!

name: Clear Conscience
text: Give a friendly minion +2/+3 and "Elusive on your opponent's turn."
flavor: Do you swear to give the buff, the whole buff, and nothing but the buff, so help you Kyrestia?

name: Framester
text: Battlecry: Shuffle 3 'Framed' cards into the opponent's deck. When drawn, they Overload for (2).
flavor: "Who put these beans in my pocket?!" -Man With Beans in Pocket

name: Habeas Corpses
text: Discover a friendly minion to resurrect and give it Rush. It dies at the end of turn.
flavor: Whoops, typo!

name: Incarceration
text: Choose a minion. It goes Dormant for 3 turns.
flavor: To Blizzard jail with you!

name: Jury Duty
text: Summon two Silver Hand Recruits. Give your Silver Hand Recruits +1/+1.
flavor: The most criminal thing about paladins is that they actually like jury duty.

name: Objection!
text: Secret: When your opponent plays a minion, Counter it.
flavor: "Sire, this is a Sindy's."

name: Tight-Lipped Witness
text: Secrets can't be revealed.
flavor: People keep asking for her award-winning vegetarian chili recipe, but she just can't spill the beans.

name: Weapons Expert
text: Battlecry: If you have a weapon equipped, give it +1/+1. Otherwise, draw a weapon.
flavor: "Yes, Your Honor, this appears to be some sort of blade."

name: Dew Process
text: For the rest of the game, players draw an extra card at the start of their turn.
flavor: All part of dewing your dew diligence.

name: Incriminating Psychic
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Copy two random cards from your opponent's hand.
flavor: Good news: He knows Kazakus's secret identity! Bad news: Now he's here.

name: Life Sentence
text: Remove a minion from the game.
flavor: Also sentenced to laugh and love.

name: Order in the Court
text: Reorder your deck from highest Cost to lowest Cost. Draw a card.
flavor: "I have nothing BUT contempt for this court!"

name: Prosecutor Mel'tranix
text: Battlecry: Your opponent can only play their left- and right-most cards on their next turn.
flavor: "Your Honor. The Defense isn't a clown, he's the whole circus."

name: Sightless Magistrate
text: Battlecry: Both players draw until they have 5 cards.
flavor: Does "Justice is Blind" still apply with Spectral Sight?

name: All Fel Breaks Loose
text: Summon a friendly Demon that died this game. Infuse (@ Demons): Summon three instead.
flavor: Maybe we should have made the bars closer together…

name: Mawsworn Bailiff
text: Taunt. Battlecry: If you have 4 or more Armor, gain +4/+4.
flavor: Bailiff, bring in the dancing lobsters!

name: Shadehound
text: Whenever this attacks, give your other Beasts +2/+2. Infuse (@ Beasts): Gain Rush.
flavor: This Shadehound wasn't just a good boy. He was the best.

name: Soul Seeker
text: Battlecry: Swap this with a random minion from your opponent's deck.
flavor: The Soul Seeker's job is to look for a snitch.

name: Contract Conjurer
text: Costs (3) less for each Secret you control.
flavor: This document looks illegally binding.

name: Defense Attorney Nathanos
text: Battlecry: Discover a friendly Deathrattle minion that died this game. Gain its Deathrattle and then trigger it.
flavor: "Your Honor, my client was simply trying a new tree trimming technique!"

name: Scribbling Stenographer
text: Rush. Costs (1) less for each card you've played this turn.
flavor: A truly staggering 180 scribbles per minute!

name: Sylvanas, the Accused
text: Battlecry: Destroy an enemy minion. Infuse (@): Take control of it instead.
flavor: Turns into 'Sylvanas, the Infused'.

name: Torghast Custodian
text: Battlecry: For each enemy minion, randomly gain Rush, Divine Shield, or Windfury.
flavor: Why is it a common? Well we couldn't make it a LEGendary minion!

name: The Jailer
text: Battlecry: Destroy your deck. This minion gains Immune.
flavor: At one point, The Jailer served as Arbiter over the souls of the Shadowlands. He was the epitome of an unbiased, righteous judge of character. WAS.

name: Snowflipper Penguin
flavor: On land, a group of penguins is called a "waddle."

name: Acherus Veteran
text: Battlecry: Give a friendly minion +1 Attack.
flavor: This is my Runeblade. There are many like it but this one is mine.

name: Animated Berserker
text: After you play a minion, deal 1 damage to it.
flavor: He'd be a lot easier to animate if he would just stand still.

name: Breath of Sindragosa
text: Deal 2 damage to a random enemy minion and Freeze it.
flavor: Is it cold in here or is it just Sindragosa?

name: Deadscale Knight
text: Lifesteal
flavor: His favorite spell is Chum Explosion.

name: Doomerang
text: Throw your weapon at a minion. It deals its damage, then returns to your hand.
flavor: Guaranteed to return your weapon directly to your hand! (Wear gloves. Thick ones.)

name: Leeching Poison
text: Give your weapon Lifesteal this turn.
flavor: No actual leeches were harmed in the creation of this card.

name: Play Dead
text: Trigger a friendly minion's Deathrattle.
flavor: He's a very literal dog.

name: Sanguine Reveler
text: Battlecry: Destroy a friendly minion and gain +2/+2.
flavor: Have some! This drink is to die for!

name: Wretched Tiller
text: Whenever this minion attacks, deal 2 damage to the enemy hero.
flavor: If you ever tried to plow permafrost, you’d be wretched, too.

name: Bring It On!
text: Gain 10 Armor. Reduce the Cost of minions in your opponent's hand by (2).
flavor: Brrr, it's cold in here. Let's hope she doesn't have an Auctioneer!

name: Brrrloc
text: Battlecry: Freeze an enemy.
flavor: He may be frozen fish, but he fights fresh!

name: Cryostasis
text: Give a minion +3/+3 and Freeze it.
flavor: We'll thaw you out when we find a cure!

name: Dark Conviction
text: Set a minion's Attack and Health to 3.
flavor: In his court, Uther is judge, jury, AND executioner…

name: Dead Man's Hand
text: Shuffle a copy of your hand into your deck.
flavor: I got two pair, Rags and Armorsmiths. What you got?

name: Defile
text: Deal 1 damage to all minions. If any die, cast this again.
flavor: This spell was originally designed to help warlocks clean up their hard drives.

name: Desperate Stand
text: Give a minion "Deathrattle: Return this to life with 1 Health."
flavor: They're grateful for the help, but most minions would prefer not dying in the first place.

name: Druid of the Swarm
text: Choose One - Transform into a 1/2 with Poisonous; or a 1/5 with Taunt.
flavor: The druid awoke from troubling dreams to find herself transformed into a giant spider.

name: Fallen Sun Cleric
text: Battlecry: Give a friendly minion +1/+1.
flavor: It's hard to keep a Shattered Sun Cleric down.

name: Forge of Souls
text: Draw 2 weapons from your deck.
flavor: Powerful weaponry forged by Bronjahm, the Godfather of Souls.

name: Gnomeferatu
text: Battlecry: Remove the top card of your opponent's deck.
flavor: She prefers the term "Glampire."

name: Ice Fishing
text: Draw 2 Murlocs from your deck.
flavor: Glow fish, war fish... blow fish, more fish...

name: Ice Walker
text: Your Hero Power also Freezes the target.
flavor: Ice Walker you say? He doesn't have feet!

name: Prince Keleseth
text: Battlecry: If your deck has no 2-Cost cards, give all minions in your deck +1/+1.
flavor: Three Princes stand before you. This one wants to buff his brothers.

name: Roll the Bones
text: Draw a card. If it has Deathrattle, cast this again.
flavor: Call it: Heads or Tailbone…

name: Shadow Ascendant
text: At the end of your turn, give another random friendly minion +1/+1.
flavor: When you're at the bottom, there's nowhere to ascend, but up.

name: Spirit Lash
text: Lifesteal Deal 1 damage to all minions.
flavor: We've got spirit, yes we do! We've got spirit, stolen from you!

name: Tainted Zealot
text: Divine Shield Spell Damage +1
flavor: The love she shares seems to go nowhere. Now she's lost her Light, tosses and turns, she can't sleep at night...

name: Toxic Arrow
text: Deal 2 damage to a minion. If it survives, give it Poisonous.
flavor: What doesn't kill you makes you toxic.

name: Tuskarr Fisherman
text: Battlecry: Give a friendly minion Spell Damage +1.
flavor: If you bring him 500 fish, he'll give you this sweet Kalu'ak Fishing Pole.

name: Venomstrike Trap
text: Secret: When one of your minions is attacked, summon a 2/3 Poisonous Cobra.
flavor: Snakes on a frozen plain.

name: Acolyte of Agony
text: Lifesteal
flavor: It takes many years of practiced study in order to fully master agony.

name: Coldwraith
text: Battlecry: If an enemy is Frozen, draw a card.
flavor: He's freezing his bones off!

name: Crypt Lord
text: Taunt After you summon a minion, gain +1 Health.
flavor: The original fifth beetle!

name: Deathspeaker
text: Battlecry: Give a friendly minion Immune this turn.
flavor: It helps to speak really, really loud.

name: Doomed Apprentice
text: Your opponent's spells cost (1) more.
flavor: Jaina was never good at keeping up apprentices.

name: Drakkari Defender
text: Taunt Overload: (3)
flavor: Sometimes, the best defense is an offensive troll.

name: Frozen Clone
text: Secret: After your opponent plays a minion, add two copies of it to your hand.
flavor: It's like déjà vu, times two.

name: Gnash
text: Give your hero +3 Attack this turn. Gain 3 Armor.
flavor: It's rude to gnash with your mouth open.

name: Happy Ghoul
text: Costs (0) if your hero was healed this turn.
flavor: When life gives you snow…

name: Howlfiend
text: Whenever this minion takes damage, discard a random card.
flavor: The problem is that he carries those cards in his mouth.

name: Howling Commander
text: Battlecry: Draw a Divine Shield minion from your deck.
flavor: Enlistment in her battalion comes with several pairs of earplugs.

name: Hyldnir Frostrider
text: Battlecry: Freeze your other minions.
flavor: Don't be fooled, that polar bear's the one in charge.

name: Ice Breaker
text: Destroy any Frozen minion damaged by this.
flavor: A great way to end a conversation.

name: Mindbreaker
text: Hero Powers are disabled.
flavor: He's a mind breaker, dream taker, ghoul trainer, don't you mess around with him.

name: Mountainfire Armor
text: Deathrattle: If it's your opponent's turn, gain 6 Armor.
flavor: Excuse me. Your mountain is on fire.

name: Prince Taldaram
text: Battlecry: If your deck has no 3-Cost cards, transform into a 3/3 copy of a minion.
flavor: Three Princes stand before you. This one wants to copy others.

name: Shadowblade
text: Battlecry: Your hero is Immune this turn.
flavor: It's tacky to call it "Shadeblade."

name: Shallow Gravedigger
text: Deathrattle: Add a random Deathrattle minion to your hand.
flavor: It's hard to put them six feet under when you're three feet tall.

name: Simulacrum
text: Copy the lowest Cost minion in your hand.
flavor: It's like déjà vu, times two.

name: Stitched Tracker
text: Battlecry: Discover a copy of a minion in your deck.
flavor: He's just exercising his right to bear arms.

name: Treachery
text: Choose a friendly minion and give it to your opponent.
flavor: Never look a gift minion in the mouth.

name: Unwilling Sacrifice
text: Choose a friendly minion. Destroy it and a random enemy minion.
flavor: Stand right... there. Perfect, perfect! Now don't move.

name: Val'kyr Soulclaimer
text: After this minion survives damage, summon a 2/2 Ghoul.
flavor: My Ghoul friend is back and you're gonna be in trouble.

name: Vryghoul
text: Deathrattle: If it's your opponent's turn, summon a 2/2 Ghoul.
flavor: It's pronounced VERY GHOUL. Don't let anyone tell you different.

name: Arfus
text: Deathrattle: Add a random Lich King card to your hand.
flavor: There must always be a Lick King.

name: Arrogant Crusader
text: Deathrattle: If it's your opponent's turn, summon a 2/2 Ghoul.
flavor: To be honest, he was kind of a jerk even BEFORE he was bitten by that ghoul.

name: Avalanche
text: Freeze a minion and deal 3 damage to adjacent ones.
flavor: One of our more snowbally cards.

name: Blood Razor
text: Battlecry and Deathrattle: Deal 1 damage to all minions.
flavor: For the close shave that you've always wanted. Caution: Very sharp.

name: Chillblade Champion
text: Charge Lifesteal
flavor: It slices, it dices, it vaporizes! The Chillblade will make a Champion out of even the lowliest gnome.

name: Corpsetaker
text: Battlecry: Gain Taunt if your deck has a Taunt minion. Repeat for Divine Shield, Lifesteal, Windfury.
flavor: Her extensive collection of corpses includes one of nearly every type. She'd love for you to join it.

name: Deathaxe Punisher
text: Battlecry: Give a random Lifesteal minion in your hand +2/+2.
flavor: Don't fear the Arcanite Reaper.

name: Eternal Servitude
text: Discover a friendly minion that died this game. Summon it.
flavor: What do you mean I don't get overtime pay for this?!

name: Exploding Bloatbat
text: Deathrattle: Deal 2 damage to all enemy minions.
flavor: We've all been there after a night of one-too-many funnel cakes.

name: Ghastly Conjurer
text: Battlecry: Add a 'Mirror Image' spell to your hand.
flavor: Wearing purple after the holidays? GHASTLY!

name: Grave Shambler
text: Whenever your weapon is destroyed, gain +1/+1.
flavor: I think one of the necromancers got a little carried away.

name: Keening Banshee
text: Whenever you play a card, remove the top 3 cards of your deck.
flavor: "What are your strengths?" the interviewer asked. "Well," she replied, "I'm really good at keening."

name: Light's Sorrow
text: After a friendly minion loses Divine Shield, gain +1 Attack.
flavor: These sorrows cut deep.

name: Lilian Voss
text: Battlecry: Replace spells in your hand with random spells (from your opponent's class).
flavor: She doesn't feel pity, or remorse, or fear. And she absolutely will not stop... ever, until all necromancers are dead.

name: Meat Wagon
text: Deathrattle: Summon a minion from your deck with less Attack than this minion.
flavor: Necromancers call it "Meals on Wheels."

name: Night Howler
text: Whenever this minion takes damage, gain +2 Attack.
flavor: Honestly, he howls during the day, too.

name: Phantom Freebooter
text: Battlecry: Gain stats equal to your weapon's.
flavor: There's no such thing as a free boot.

name: Prince Valanar
text: Battlecry: If your deck has no 4-Cost cards, gain Lifesteal and Taunt.
flavor: Three Princes stand before you. This one devours one after another.

name: Professor Putricide
text: After you play a Secret, put a random Hunter Secret into the battlefield.
flavor: Among his more notable inventions: A tentacle-groomer, a plague that would wipe out all life on Azeroth, and a fidget spinner.

name: Rattling Rascal
text: Battlecry: Summon a 5/5 Skeleton. Deathrattle: Summon one for your opponent.
flavor: Don't give up, skeleton!

name: Runeforge Haunter
text: During your turn, your weapon doesn't lose Durability.
flavor: Don't worry, he'll keep an eye on that for you.

name: Saronite Chain Gang
text: Taunt Battlecry: Summon a copy of this minion.
flavor: Desperately needs some alone time.

name: Strongshell Scavenger
text: Battlecry: Give your Taunt minions +2/+2.
flavor: It isn't "grave robbing" when there's no grave. It's just scavenging…

name: Ticking Abomination
text: Deathrattle: Deal 5 damage to your minions.
flavor: Abomination. Emphasis on the second syllable.

name: Wicked Skeleton
text: Battlecry: Gain +1/+1 for each minion that died this turn.
flavor: It's minions like these that give normal, law-abiding skeletons a bad rap.

name: Blood-Queen Lana'thel
text: Lifesteal Has +1 Attack for each card you've discarded this game.
flavor: As a young blood-princess she learned the proper way for a lady to curtsy, how to address fellow members of royalty, and how to bite them.

name: Bloodworm
text: Lifesteal
flavor: Queen Lana'thel insists on one of these, fried, every morning for breakfast.

name: Bolvar, Fireblood
text: Divine Shield After a friendly minion loses Divine Shield, gain +2 Attack.
flavor: He's so hot right now.

name: Bone Baron
text: Deathrattle: Add two 1/1 Skeletons to your hand.
flavor: "Oil," "Rail," and "Blubber" were already taken.

name: Corpse Raiser
text: Battlecry: Give a friendly minion "Deathrattle: Resummon this minion."
flavor: He was just minding his business, farming corpses, when you meddling adventurers came along.

name: Corpse Widow
text: Your Deathrattle cards cost (2) less.
flavor: Her marriage survived death, but it decayed pretty quickly after that.

name: Death Revenant
text: Battlecry: Gain +1/+1 for each damaged minion.
flavor: How's everyone doing? Hurt? Bleeding? Wounded? ... Excellent.

name: Despicable Dreadlord
text: At the end of your turn, deal 1 damage to all enemy minions.
flavor: He's deathspicable.

name: Devour Mind
text: Copy 3 cards in your opponent's deck and add them to your hand.
flavor: A mind is a terrible thing to waste. Seconds, anyone?

name: Fatespinner
text: Choose a Deathrattle (Secretly) - Deal 3 damage to all minions; or Give them +2/+2.
flavor: Her clothing? Pure silk, of course.

name: Skelemancer
text: Deathrattle: If it's your opponent's turn, summon an 8/8 Skeleton.
flavor: What do you mean there's no such thing as "Skelemancy?" But "Dinomancy" is ok?

name: Sunborne Val'kyr
text: Battlecry: Give adjacent minions +2 Health.
flavor: Bring valor to Odyn's halls, Champion!

name: Thrall, Deathseer
text: Battlecry: Transform your minions into random ones that cost (2) more.
flavor: "Do not be afraid. Approach. The dead will sleep… for now."

name: Tomb Lurker
text: Battlecry: Add a random Deathrattle minion that died this game to your hand.
flavor: She hangs out in all the tombs, but she rarely posts.

name: Venomancer
text: Poisonous
flavor: Eight times the death of regular-mancers.

name: Voodoo Hexxer
text: Taunt Freeze any character damaged by this minion.
flavor: The Silver Hand recruits shuddered in terror when they saw the dreaded totem of the Hexxer: A tiny little snowman, impaled with pins.

name: Webweave
text: Summon two 1/2 Poisonous Spiders.
flavor: O, what a tangled web we weave, hoping spiders dodge the cleave.

name: Blackguard
text: Whenever your hero is healed, deal that much damage to a random enemy minion.
flavor: "Did I ever tell you the story of when I single-handedly took down a 29/29 C'thun?" - Reno Jackson

name: Bone Drake
text: Deathrattle: Add a random Dragon to your hand.
flavor: The bone drake brings all the dragons to the yard. He would teach you, but you have no cards.

name: Deathstalker Rexxar
text: Battlecry: Deal 2 damage to all enemy minions.
flavor: "You were too slow, old friend. The hunt began long ago. And now... it will never end."

name: Embrace Darkness
text: Choose an enemy minion. At the start of your turn, gain control of it.
flavor: Once you both get comfortable, darkness is actually pretty snuggly.

name: Furnacefire Colossus
text: Battlecry: Discard all weapons from your hand and gain their stats.
flavor: Smelts in his mouth, not in your hand.

name: Moorabi
text: Whenever another minion is Frozen, add a copy of it to your hand.
flavor: Most disturbing is how Moorabi covers all those frozen minions with flavored syrup.

name: Necrotic Geist
text: Whenever one of your other minions dies, summon a 2/2 Ghoul.
flavor: An eye for an eye, and a ghoul for a ghoul.

name: Nerubian Unraveler
text: Spells cost (2) more.
flavor: He loves a good yarn.

name: Skulking Geist
text: Battlecry: Destroy all 1-Cost spells in both hands and decks.
flavor: It's as though a million Jade Idols cried out, and were suddenly silenced.

name: Spectral Pillager
text: Combo: Deal damage equal to the number of other cards you've played this turn.
flavor: It turns out you CAN take it with you.

name: Spellweaver
text: Spell Damage +2
flavor: Spells offer twice the moisture wicking of cotton.

name: Spreading Plague
text: Summon a 1/5 Scarab with Taunt. If your opponent has more minions, cast this again.
flavor: In the past, plagues were spread by mice or fleas. These days they're spread by elves.

name: Abominable Bowman
text: Deathrattle: Summon a random friendly Beast that died this game.
flavor: Frosty the Bowman... was an angry hateful soul... with a fresh hewn bow and a missing nose...

name: Archbishop Benedictus
text: Battlecry: Shuffle a copy of your opponent's deck into your deck.
flavor: Nobody expects the Archbishop's Benediction!

name: Bonemare
text: Battlecry: Give a friendly minion +4/+4 and Taunt.
flavor: Attacks her job with unbridled enthusiasm.

name: Malfurion the Pestilent
text: Choose One - Summon 2 Poisonous Spiders; or 2 Scarabs with Taunt.
flavor: "Cenarius once taught me about the precarious balance between life and death. I have come to understand: there IS no balance. Death always wins."

name: Shadow Essence
text: Summon a 5/5 copy of a random minion in your deck.
flavor: Difficult to bottle up and sell. But it packs a punch.

name: Glacial Mysteries
text: Put one of each Secret from your deck into the battlefield.
flavor: The secret is in the frosting.

name: Rotface
text: After this minion survives damage, summon a random Legendary minion.
flavor: Daddy! I think I made a Legendary!

name: Scourgelord Garrosh
text: Battlecry: Equip a 4/3 Shadowmourne that also damages adjacent minions.
flavor: "You dare to challenge me? Come! Draw your last breath - and then, you are mine."

name: Shadowreaper Anduin
text: Battlecry: Destroy all minions with 5 or more Attack.
flavor: "I will tell you what Velen never taught me. Whosoever stands before the Light… inevitably casts a shadow."

name: Sindragosa
text: Battlecry: Summon two 0/1 Frozen Champions.
flavor: "I recognize your effort but I think your magic still has room for improvement." - Sindragosa after taking a class on giving constructive feedback.

name: The Lich King
text: Taunt At the end of your turn, add a random Lich King card to your hand.
flavor: "All that I am: anger, cruelty, vengeance, 8 attack - I bestow upon you, my chosen knight."

name: Frost Lich Jaina
text: Battlecry: Summon a 3/6 Water Elemental. Your Elementals have Lifesteal this game.
flavor: "Arthas was a spoiled child, playing with toys he could neither control nor understand. Come into the cold. I will show you the true power of the Frozen Throne."

name: Hadronox
text: Deathrattle: Summon your Taunt minions that died this game.
flavor: The viziers of Azjol-Nerub released Hadronox as a last-ditch effort to hold back the Lich King. They did so by VERY carefully scooping him up in a LARGE newspaper and releasing him.

name: Obsidian Statue
text: Taunt, Lifesteal Deathrattle: Destroy a random enemy minion.
flavor: The original artist spent many hours with a fine chisel perfecting the facial expression for maximum tauntiness.

name: The Sunwell
text: Fill your hand with random spells. Costs (1) less for each other card in your hand.
flavor: The Lich King had extinguished the light of the Sunwell once before - it will take all the might Silvermoon can muster to defend it!

name: Uther of the Ebon Blade
text: Battlecry: Equip a 5/3 Lifesteal weapon.
flavor: "Step forward. Confess! Once I was a mere servant of the Light. Now I alone stand in judgement."

name: Valeera the Hollow
text: Battlecry: Gain Stealth until your next turn.
flavor: "Run away. Hide in your precious keeps, behind your walls and your bodyguards. Night always falls, and shadows will fill your hallowed halls. One day, one of those shadows will be me."

name: Bloodreaver Gul'dan
text: Battlecry: Summon all friendly Demons that died this game.
flavor: "Still you refuse to bend your knee? None can escape death, you old fool. And in death… all will serve me…"

name: Ultimate Infestation
text: Deal 5 damage. Draw 5 cards. Gain 5 Armor. Summon a 5/5 Ghoul.
flavor: Ghouls in the pipe, five by five.

name: Snowfury Giant
text: Costs (1) less for each Mana Crystal you've Overloaded this game.
flavor: This minion goes all the way to 11!

name: Horn of Winter
text: Refresh 2 Mana Crystals.
flavor: Much better than the Horn of Loseter.

name: Shadow of Demise
text: Each time you cast a spell, transform this into a copy of it.
flavor: Each time you cast a spell, transform this into a copy of its flavor text.

name: Undying Allies
text: After you play an Undead this turn, give it Reborn.
flavor: Best friends FOREVER.

name: Animate Dead
text: Resurrect a friendly minion that costs (3) or less.
flavor: In the old days they used to animate the dead one bone at a time... it's all done by computer now.

name: Arcane Bolt
text: Deal 2 damage. Manathirst (8): Deal 3 damage instead.
flavor: Just you wait until I have 8 mana!

name: Arcane Wyrm
text: Battlecry: Add an Arcane Bolt to your hand.
flavor: Arcane Bolt on you, Arcane Bolt on your cow, Arcane Bolt on your whole family!

name: Arms Dealer
text: After you summon an Undead, give it +1 Attack.
flavor: Need a hand?

name: Body Bagger
text: Battlecry: Gain a Corpse.
flavor: Gotta get that bag.

name: Bone Breaker
text: After your hero attacks a minion, deal 2 damage to the enemy hero.
flavor: Many weapons are bone breakers if you swing hard enough.

name: Concoctor
text: Battlecry: Add a random Concoction to your hand.
flavor: "A dash of death, with a pinch of death, and a sprinkle of… death!"

name: Crystalsmith Cultist
text: Battlecry: If you're holding a Shadow spell, gain +1/+1.
flavor: "I just think they're neat."

name: Devourer of Souls
text: After a friendly minion dies, gain its Deathrattle.
flavor: Winner of the Scourge's annual funnel cake devouring contest 12 years running.

name: Feast and Famine
text: Give your hero +3 Attack this turn. Manathirst (4): And Lifesteal.
flavor: Please sir, may I have some armor?

name: Fierce Outsider
text: Rush Outcast: Your next Outcast card costs (1) less.
flavor: Look, if you stopped breaking stuff you wouldn't have to stay outside.

name: Flight of the Bronze
text: Discover a Dragon. Manathirst (7): Summon a 5/5 Drake with Taunt.
flavor: You're telling me Hearthstone will make a 1 Mana 5/5 with Taunt? Maybe when bronze flies!

name: Foul Egg
text: Deathrattle: Summon a 3/3 Undead Chicken.
flavor: Definitely expired.

name: Ghostly Strike
text: Deal 1 damage. Combo: Draw a card.
flavor: …What are their demands?

name: Heart Strike
text: Deal 3 damage to a minion. If it dies, gain a Corpse.
flavor: Love hurts.

name: Icy Touch
text: Deal 2 damage to an enemy and Freeze it.
flavor: Vibe check.

name: Last Stand
text: Draw a Taunt minion. Manathirst (7): Double its stats.
flavor: If you play two Last Stands in one game, you're a liar.

name: Lingering Zombie
text: Deathrattle: Summon a 1/1 Disarmed Zombie with "Deathrattle: Summon a 1/1 Zombie."

name: Noxious Cadaver
text: Battlecry: Deal 2 damage to an enemy and your hero.
flavor: Shouldn't have eaten that gas station sushi.

name: Plagued Grain
text: Gain 4 Corpses. Shuffle four Crates into your deck that summon a 2/2 Undead when drawn.
flavor: Oh, don’t mind the smell. They're just aged!

name: Ricochet Shot
text: Deal 1 damage to three random enemies.
flavor: Simple geometry? Actually, I find it's quite complex.

name: Runeforging
text: Draw a weapon. Spend a Corpse to reduce its Cost by (1).
flavor: I swear the runes are genuine!

name: Sanguine Soldier
text: Divine Shield Battlecry: Deal 2 damage to your hero.
flavor: They just need someone to ouch for them.

name: Scourge Tamer
text: Battlecry: Craft a custom Zombeast.
flavor: He's a hunter AND a gatherer.

name: Scourge Troll
text: Deathrattles given to this minion trigger twice.
flavor: This is where I'd put my Deathrattle - IF I HAD ONE!

name: Skeletal Sidekick
text: Battlecry: Give a friendly Undead +2 Attack.
flavor: He's got your back. And your arm.

name: Sunfury Champion
text: After you cast a Fire spell, deal 1 damage to all minions.
flavor: Champion of the Great Blood Elf Bake Off 12 years running.

name: Unleash Fel
text: Deal 1 damage to all enemies. Manathirst (6): With Lifesteal.
flavor: Why'd you put it on a leash in the first place?

name: Wailing Banshee
text: Deathrattle: Give a random friendly Undead +2/+1.
flavor: :O

name: Wither
text: Choose a minion. Each friendly Undead steals 1 Attack and Health from it.
flavor: The opponent's minion can't live wither without you.

name: Ymirjar Frostbreaker
text: Battlecry: Gain +1 Attack for each Frost spell in your hand.
flavor: Also gains +1 Attack for each time your opponent mispronounces his name.

name: Arcane Quiver
text: Discover a spell from your deck. If it's Arcane, give it Spell Damage +1.
flavor: "Quiver in fear!" - The Lich King "Ok." - Me

name: Astalor Bloodsworn
text: Battlecry: Add Astalor, the Protector to your hand. Manathirst (@): Deal 2 damage.
flavor: I hear his third phase is even more intense.

name: Battlefield Necromancer
text: At the end of your turn, raise a Corpse as a 1/3 Risen Footman with Taunt.
flavor: Coming soon: the Hand Necromancer and the Deck Necromancer.

name: Blazing Power
text: Give a minion +1/+1. Repeat for each damaged friendly character.
flavor: Apply heat directly to the damaged area.

name: Blood Matriarch Liadrin
text: After you summon a minion with less Attack than this, give it Divine Shield and Rush.
flavor: All's fair in blood and war.

name: Blood Tap
text: Give all minions in your hand +1/+1. Spend 2 Corpses to give them +1/+1 more.
flavor: Come join us in the tavern! We have whatever you're drinking on tap. Yes, even that.

name: Bone Flinger
text: Battlecry: If a friendly Undead died after your last turn, deal 2 damage.
flavor: It’s the scourge bringing, plague slinging, bone flinging basher!

name: Bonedigger Geist
text: Battlecry: Spend a Corpse to gain +1/+2.
flavor: He's a grave-half-full kind of geist.

name: Chitinous Plating
text: Gain 4 Armor. At the start of your next turn, gain 4 more.
flavor: Durable, detachable and dishwasher safe.

name: Conjured Arrow
text: Deal 2 damage to a minion. Manathirst (6): Draw that many cards.
flavor: We just call them "cursors".

name: Coroner
text: Battlecry: Freeze an enemy minion. Manathirst (6): Silence it first.
flavor: It was at this moment the Coroner decided to become a farmer instead.

name: Dark Transformation
text: Transform an Undead into a 4/5 Undead Monstrosity with Rush.
flavor: The Northrend Arm Wrestling Championship just found its new champion.

name: Deathchiller
text: After you cast a spell, deal 1 damage to two random enemies.
flavor: Man, death is like the most chill state... you've got nothing to do but relax.

name: Deathweaver Aura
text: Give a minion "Deathrattle: Summon two 3/2 Zombies." Overload: (1)
flavor: Knitting is a harmless hobby. Weaving, though...

name: Defrost
text: Draw a card. Spend 2 Corpses to draw another.
flavor: Shouldn't this NOT be a Frost spell?

name: Embers of Strength
text: Summon two 1/2 Guards with Taunt. Manathirst (6): Give them +1/+2.
flavor: Remember, remember, the 1/2's of Ember.

name: For Quel'Thalas!
text: Give a friendly minion +3 Attack. Give your hero +2 Attack this turn.
flavor: For kwell-kell.. for kell… for kwee- for the city!

name: Frost Strike
text: Deal 3 damage to a minion. If it dies, Discover a Frost Rune card.
flavor: Anyone up for some frost bowling?

name: Ghoulish Alchemist
text: Battlecry: Your next Concoction costs (0).
flavor: AND I THREW IT ON THE GROUND!

name: Harbinger of Winter
text: Deathrattle: Draw a Frost spell.
flavor: Winter: it be comin'.

name: Hematurge
text: Battlecry: Spend a Corpse to Discover a Blood Rune card.
flavor: She's here to PUMP! YOU UP!

name: Incorporeal Corporal
text: After this minion attacks, destroy it.
flavor: You won't believe how long this was called "Incorporal Corporeal"…

name: Infected Peasant
text: Deathrattle: Summon a 2/2 Undead Peasant.
flavor: The peasants are revolting!

name: Magister's Apprentice
text: Your Arcane spells cost (1) less.
flavor: "If this is the work I'll be doing, maybe I don't want to be just like you someday..."

name: Mark of Scorn
text: Draw a card. If it's not a minion, deal 4 damage to the lowest Health enemy.
flavor: Threat Level who? Mark of Scorn!

name: Mind Eater
text: Deathrattle: Add a copy of a card in your opponent's deck to your hand.
flavor: Watch out brain, she'll chew you up! She's a Mind Eater!

name: Necrotic Mortician
text: Battlecry: If a friendly Undead died after your last turn, Discover an Unholy Rune card.
flavor: Her hair, just like her name, is full of 'tic's.

name: Nerubian Flyer
text: Battlecry: If a friendly Undead died after your last turn, summon a 2/2 Nerubian.
flavor: Undead Air Miles only cover Northrend and the surrounding coast.

name: Obliterate
text: Destroy a minion. Deal 3 damage to your hero.
flavor: Why is 6 afraid of 7? Because Obliterate 9!

name: Plague Strike
text: Deal 3 damage to a minion. If it dies, summon a 2/2 Zombie with Rush.
flavor: Not wanting to infect anyone with his cold, the Death Knight politely coughed into his shoulder.

name: Potion Belt
text: Discover 2 Concoctions.
flavor: Pick your poison.

name: Potionmaster Putricide
text: After a minion dies, add a Concoction to your hand.
flavor: "Good news everyone! I'm a Rogue card now!"

name: Prismatic Elemental
text: Battlecry: Discover a spell from any class. It costs (1) less.
flavor: Disappointed they were rejected from the Magical Guardian tryouts.

name: Rotten Rodent
text: Battlecry: Reduce the Cost of all Deathrattle cards in your deck by (1).
flavor: It's dead, but it's not a mouse.

name: Shallow Grave
text: Trigger a friendly minion's Deathrattle, then destroy it.
flavor: Jumpscare!

name: Silvermoon Farstrider
text: Battlecry: Give all Arcane spells in your hand Spell Damage +1.
flavor: Surprisingly nearsighted.

name: Umbral Geist
text: Deathrattle: Add a random Shadow spell to your hand.
flavor: “After all, one can't leave his shadow lying about and not miss it sooner or later, don't you agree?”

name: Unholy Frenzy
text: Choose an enemy minion. Your minions attack it. Resummon any that die.
flavor: GROUP HUG!

name: Vampiric Blood
text: Give your hero +5 Health. Spend 3 Corpses to gain 5 more and draw a card.
flavor: BLEH, BLEH BLEH!

name: Vast Wisdom
text: Discover two spells that cost (3) or less. Swap their Costs.
flavor: My wisdom is SO vast that I can count up to THREE!

name: Vicious Bloodworm
text: Battlecry: Give a minion in your hand Attack equal to this minion's Attack.
flavor: Not to be confused with the Viscous Bloodworm.

name: Vrykul Necrolyte
text: Battlecry: Give a friendly minion "Deathrattle: Summon a 2/2 Zombie with Rush."
flavor: If at first you don't succeed, vry, vry again.

name: Wretched Exile
text: After you play an Outcast card, add a random Outcast card to your hand.
flavor: If you're cold, they're cold. Let your wretches inside.

name: Acolyte of Death
text: After a friendly Undead dies, draw a card.
flavor: "I see dead people. A LOT of dead people."

name: Amber Whelp
text: Battlecry: If you're holding a Dragon, deal 3 damage.
flavor: What is a Bronze Whelp's favorite garnish? A little thyme!

name: Anti-Magic Shell
text: Give your minions +1/+1 and Elusive.
flavor: Using a spell to counter magic - a bit hypocritical don't you think?

name: Arcsplitter
text: Deathrattle: Add 2 Arcane Bolts to your hand.
flavor: Shockspitter, Arcsplitter, what's next?

name: Asphyxiate
text: Destroy the highest Attack enemy minion.
flavor: I find your abundance of Attack disturbing.
