flavor: "Me should not have taken candle."

name: Parched Desperado
text: Battlecry: If you've cast a spell while holding this, give your hero +3 Attack this turn.
flavor: I'm green And I'm about to die Da ba dee da ba di

name: Pile of Bones
text: Deathrattle: The next time you Excavate, resummon this.
flavor: It's a very well-organized pile, I'll give you that.

name: Pocket Sand
text: Deal 3 damage. Quickdraw: Your opponent's next card costs (1) more.
flavor: I was only trying to get it in your eyes, man. YOU didn't need to open your mouth like that!

name: Rehydrate
text: Restore 7 Health. Quickdraw: Refresh 2 Mana Crystals.
flavor: Just doing our part as the Hearthstone development team in reminding you to drink more water!

name: Saloon Brewmaster
text: Battlecry: Return a friendly minion to your hand. Give it +2/+2.
flavor: Brewmaster Bru brought Barrelbrim bursting barrels of barely brewed barley brew. Barrelbrim bought Bru's barley brew, barring the barrels broken from the brazen brunch brawl.

name: Shell Game
text: Get a random Epic, Rare, and Common card from other classes.
flavor: I thiiink… It's under all three of 'em!

name: Showdown!
text: Both players summon three 3/3 Outlaws. Give yours Rush.
flavor: An epic confrontation between the outlaws and the in-laws.

name: Splish-Splash Whelp
text: Battlecry: If you're holding a Dragon, gain an empty Mana Crystal.
flavor: Little Whelpy, you're the one You make Mana lots of fun

name: Stargazing
text: Draw a different Arcane spell. If you play it this turn, it casts twice.
flavor: See those dots up there? Those are called "stars." Except for that one. That's called an "airplane."

name: Ten Gallon Hat
text: Draw a minion. Give it +1/+1 and "Deathrattle: Get a Ten Gallon Hat."
flavor: It actually only holds three quarters of a gallon, but that doesn't sound as good.

name: Trapdoor Spider
text: Stealth, Poisonous After your opponent plays a minion, attack it.
flavor: I can respect that they're important for the ecosystem, as long as you keep them waaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaay over there.

name: Trusty Companion
text: Give a minion +2/+3. If it has a minion type, draw one of that type.
flavor: Textbook big-sibling and little-sibling relationship.

name: Unlucky Powderman
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Give Taunt minions in your hand and deck +1/+1.
flavor: Welp, guess I'll die... again.

name: Whelp Wrangler
text: At the end of your turn, get a 1/2 Whelp with Taunt.
flavor: "Gosh darn it! How did these winged, airborne creatures manage to escape my knee-high, fenced enclosure AGAIN!?"

name: Antique Flinger
text: Battlecry: If you've Excavated twice, destroy an enemy minion.
flavor: One man's treasure is another man's statue to the face.

name: Azerite Vein
text: Secret: When the enemy plays a card on the turn that it entered their hand, get a copy that costs (0).
flavor: When the ground trembles near it, are those earthquakes or heartbeats?

name: Battlepickaxe
text: After you play a Taunt minion, gain +1 Durability.
flavor: You can pick your battles, and you can pick your axes, but you can't uh… pick your friends' battlepickaxes?

name: Benevolent Banker
text: Battlecry: Discover a spell from your deck. Quickdraw: Enemy deck instead.
flavor: "Oh no, you've got me confused. I'm Ben, the evil ent banker. I only work with evil trees!"

name: Blindeye Sharpshooter
text: After you play a Naga, deal 2 damage to a random enemy and draw a spell. (Then switch!)@After you cast a spell, deal 2 damage to a random enemy and draw a Naga. (Then switch!)
flavor: "Bullseye… I think."

name: Bounty Board
text: Your Excavate, Quickdraw, Tradeable, and Legendary cards cost (1) less.
flavor: Reno's desire to be a face known around the Badlands might have backfired a little bit.

name: Bounty Wrangler
text: Quickdraw or Combo: Get a Coin.
flavor: With a smile like that and Coins in her hands, she's one greedy grinner.

name: Bovine Skeleton
text: Deathrattle: If this has 4 or more Attack, summon a Bovine Skeleton.
flavor: The secret cow level has been unearthed.

name: Corpse Farm
text: Spend up to 8 Corpses to summon a random minion of that Cost.
flavor: It ain't much, but it's dishonest work.

name: Crop Rotation
text: Summon four 1/1 Undead with Rush that die at the end of turn.
flavor: "Dave, you're never gunna believe this! The plants ARE the zombies!"

name: Dehydrate
text: Lifesteal. Deal 4 damage to a minion. Quickdraw: Costs (1).
flavor: JUST A LITTLE FURTHER LITTLE GUY, YOU CAN MAKE IT!!!

name: Deputization Aura
text: Your left-most minion has +2 Attack and Lifesteal. Lasts @ turns.
flavor: You're my favorite deput- oh. You died… Ok just kidding, THAT guy is my favorite deputy.

name: Eroded Sediment
text: Battlecry: If you played an Elemental last turn, Discover any Elemental from the past.
flavor: A perfect minion for those feeling sedimental about their past.

name: Farm Hand
text: Battlecry: Discover an Undead. Quickdraw: It costs (2) less.
flavor: I know it's an Undead hand, but bending your pinky in that way can NOT be good for your joints.

name: Furnace Fuel
text: When this is played, discarded, or destroyed, draw 2 cards.
flavor: Remember Ultrasaur? This is him now. Feel old yet?

name: Gattlesnake
text: At the end of your turn, load two bullets that deal 1 damage each. Deathrattle: Fire at random enemies!
flavor: He used to be an ordinary snake until he slithered through a saloon during a brawl and walked out looking like this.

name: High Noon Duelist
text: Deathrattle: Both players DRAW! Destroy the card that costs less.
flavor: "My ultimate is rea- ah, errr, I mean, I have enough Mana."

name: Holy Cowboy
text: Battlecry: Your next Holy spell costs (2) less.
flavor: Wait, but… Isn't he more of a 'holy kodoboy'?

name: Injured Hauler
text: Battlecry: Deal 4 damage to this minion. Overheal: Deal 2 damage to all enemy minions.
flavor: With how many cacti are all over the Badlands, this job has to be some sort of sick joke.

name: Linedance Partner
text: Battlecry: If you're holding another 3-Cost card, summon a random 3-Cost minion.
flavor: Where did you come from? (Linedance Partner's Battlecry) Where did you go? (Face)

name: Load the Chamber
text: Deal 2 damage. Your next Naga, Fel spell, and weapon cost (1) less.
flavor: Wait! Before we duel, I gotta install these shaders.

name: Minecart Cruiser
text: Rush, Overload: (2) Battlecry: If you played an Elemental last turn, don't Overload.
flavor: Where are you drivin', Minecart Cruiser? Where is your bounty, fortune, and fame?

name: Ogre-Gang Outlaw
text: Rush 50% chance to attack the wrong enemy.
flavor: Why don't they just buy another hat?

name: Pip the Potent
text: Battlecry: Copy each 1-Cost card in your hand.
flavor: One time, I was trying to get Pip's attention to warn her that the dangerous outlaw Cheery Ollie, who also goes by just 'O', was headed her way. "Pip! Pip! Cheery O!", I shouted.

name: Reap What You Sow
text: Deal 3 damage. Excavate a treasure.
flavor: With a hat like that, I'd say their tailor did all of the sowing.

name: Reinforced Plating
text: Gain 6 Armor. Excavate a treasure.
flavor: I am become death, destroyer of azerite.

name: Saddle Up!
text: Give your minions "Deathrattle: Summon a random Beast that costs (3) or less."
flavor: And then they rode off into the sunset, not knowing they left their stove on.

name: Silver Serpent
text: Rush, Poisonous Quickdraw: Gain Immune this turn.
flavor: Skilled at exploring hidden temples.

name: Sludge on Wheels
text: Rush. Whenever this takes damage, get a Barrel of Sludge and add one to the bottom of your deck.
flavor: Cruisin' for an oozin'.

name: Snake Eyes
text: Battlecry: Roll two dice, then Discover two cards of those Costs. (Doubles get an extra Discover!)
flavor: Hey, put ALL of your hands on the table!

name: Spirit of the Badlands
text: Battlecry: If your deck started with no duplicates, get a permanent Mirage.
flavor: That's the spirit! Of the Badlands.

name: Take to the Skies
text: Draw two Dragons. Give them +1/+1.
flavor: This is one step above reaching for the skies.

name: Trolley Problem
text: Discard your lowest Cost spell. Summon two 3/3 Tram Cars with Rush. Quickdraw: Don't discard.
flavor: If only there were thousands of hypotheticals to prepare me for this moment!

name: Velarok Windblade
text: While this is in your hand, play a card from another class to reveal Velarok's true form!
flavor: His deceptive manipulations have dug the Bloodrock Company into a hole they can't get out of.

name: Azerite Chain Gang
text: Taunt Battlecry and Quickdraw: Summon a copy of this.
flavor: How long can this go on? For 6 years at least!

name: Camouflage Mount
text: Give a minion +3/+3 and a random Bonus Effect. When it dies, summon a Chameleon.
flavor: What mount? I don't see anything…

name: Dang-Blasted Elemental
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Deal 2 damage to all minions except friendly Elementals.
flavor: We were told that "Dag-Nabbin' Dang-Blastin' Rootin'-Tootin' High-Falutin' Elemental" was too long.

name: Desert Nestmatron
text: Taunt. Battlecry: If you're holding a Dragon, refresh 4 Mana Crystals.
flavor: Not as sweet as the Dessert Nestmatron, but still just as refreshing!

name: Detonation Juggernaut
text: Taunt. Battlecry: Give Taunt minions in your hand +2/+2.
flavor: Did you really need a whole giant mecha-suit just for one bundle of dynamite?

name: Drilly the Kid
text: Battlecry, Quickdraw, and Deathrattle: Excavate a treasure.
flavor: "I HATE that nickname. Call me Drilliam!"

name: Fan the Hammer
text: Deal 6 damage split among the lowest Health enemies.
flavor: I thought Kurtrus was more of a fan of glaives.

name: Gaslight Gatekeeper
text: Battlecry: Shuffle your hand into your deck, then draw that many cards.
flavor: This girl is such a boss.

name: Invasive Shadeleaf
text: Deal 10 damage to an enemy minion. Save any excess in a 1-Cost Bottle.
flavor: Don't throw shade, bottle it!

name: Maw and Paw
text: At the end of your turn, gain 5 Corpses. At the start of your turn, spend 5 Corpses to give your hero +5 Health.
flavor: Home is where the disfigured, rotten heart is.

name: Mo'arg Drillfist
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Excavate a treasure.
flavor: Also functions as the town dentist.

name: Ogre-Gang Rider
text: Rush 50% chance to give your hero +3 Attack this turn instead of attacking.
flavor: Doesn't know his ride from his left.

name: Overflow Surger
text: Battlecry: Summon a copy of this for each turn in a row you've played an Elemental.@ (@)
flavor: The drip on this elemental is straight fire!

name: Pop'gar the Putrid
text: Your Fel spells cost (2) less and have Lifesteal. Battlecry: Get two Barrels of Sludge.
flavor: All around the arid badlands The Outlaws chased the Townsfolk Gerry had a train full of sludge POP! goes the sludge train

name: Posse Possession
text: Summon a 4/4 copy of a random minion in your opponent's hand.
flavor: Keep your friends close, your enemies closer, and your shadows at gunpoint.

name: Reliquary Researcher
text: Battlecry: If you've Excavated twice, cast two random Mage Secrets.
flavor: What good is a researcher if they're just gunna keep it all a secret?

name: Rowdy Partner
text: Battlecry: If you're holding another 4-Cost card, deal 4 damage.
flavor: Rowdy, partner!

name: Sheriff Barrelbrim
text: Battlecry: If you have 20 or less Health, open the Badlands Jail.
flavor: Is that Sheriff Barrelbrim, owner of the Badlands Barrelbuilding?

name: Skeleton Crew
text: Battlecry: Excavate a treasure. It costs (0).
flavor: They don't sweat, breathe or need lit candles... what more could you ask?

name: Slagmaw the Slumbering
text: Rush, Taunt Dormant for 6 turns. (Excavate to awaken 2 turns sooner!)
flavor: You delved too greedily and too deep. You know what they awoke in the darkness of the Badlands: Rush and Taunt.

name: Snake Oil Seller
text: Deathrattle: Shuffle 2 Tradeable Snake Oils into your opponent's deck.
flavor: This oil is absolutely essential to your gameplan.

name: Spinetail Drake
text: Battlecry: If you're holding a Dragon, deal 5 damage to an enemy minion.
flavor: Mortal enemy of Cactus Cutter.

name: Starshooter
text: After your hero attacks, get an Arcane Shot.
flavor: Shoot for the stars! And if you miss, just don't hit me.

name: Tae'thelan Bloodwatcher
text: Cards that didn't start in your deck cost (4) less (but not less than 1).
flavor: He's a big fan of Control Death Knight live streams.

name: Theldurin the Lost
text: Battlecry: If your deck started with no duplicates, gain Immune this turn and attack all enemies.
flavor: He might be lost, but he knows where you can find these hands.

name: Tram Heist
text: Get a copy of each card your opponent played last turn.
flavor: How are they gunna steal the whole tram!?

name: Waste Remover
text: At the end of your turn, destroy the bottom 3 cards of your deck.
flavor: Always follow the three Rs: REDUCE their world to ash, REUSE their bones as paperweights, and RECYCLE!

name: Burrow Buster
text: Rush Battlecry: Excavate a treasure.
flavor: We almost went with the name "Giant Drill", but then it would've HAD to be an 8/8.

name: Cattle Rustler
text: Battlecry: Draw a Beast. It costs (3) less.
flavor: What once started as a small-time cat burglary gig has turned into a life of cattle rustling. What a shame.

name: Doctor Holli'dae
text: Battlecry: If your deck started with no duplicates, equip the Staff of the Nine Frogs.
flavor: If anything can heal the Badlands, it is the power of frogs!

name: Gunslinger Kurtrus
text: Battlecry: If your deck started with no duplicates, fire six 2 damage shots at minions in the enemy's hand.
flavor: "I have given up (a single copy of) EVERYTHING! What have YOU sacrificed?"

name: Lawful Longarm
text: Rush, Lifesteal Battlecry: Gain +1 Attack for each card in your hand.
flavor: Loves to lob law bombs from his law blog.

name: Living Prairie
text: Battlecry: If you played an Elemental last turn, summon two 3/3 Cows with Rush.
flavor: Whoooooa, we're half way there Whooa-oh, -

name: Mes'Adune the Fractured
text: Battlecry: Draw an Elemental. Split it into two halves.
flavor: Cracking open an elemental with the boys.

name: Ogre-Gang Ace
text: Rush Whenever this attacks, gain Divine Shield. (50% chance to gain Lifesteal instead.)
flavor: 100% chance to not play by the rules.

name: Spurfang
text: Battlecry and Deathrattle: Summon a random Beast with Cost equal to this minion's Attack.
flavor: He's always smiling… Not by choice, but because it hurts to close his mouth.

name: Swarm of Lightbugs
text: Summon 10 1/1 Lightbugs with Lifesteal. Save any excess in a 1-Cost Bottle.
flavor: No, I asked for 'lightNING in a bottle'!

name: Wishing Well
text: After you play a Coin, get a random Legendary minion from another class and set its Cost to (1).
flavor: Wishing upon a star? Pssshhh, that's so childish. Anyways, let me throw all my Coins into this well.

name: Blast Tortoise
text: Taunt Battlecry: Deal damage to all enemy minions equal to this minion's Attack.
flavor: Who's that minion? ... Iiiiit's Blast Tortoise! "Blast tortoise."

name: Blastmage Miner
text: Battlecry: Excavate a treasure. For each card in your hand, deal 1 damage to a random enemy.
flavor: "So anyways, I started blastminin'!"

name: Kingpin Pud
text: Battlecry: Resurrect your Ogre-Gang. Give them Windfury.
flavor: The good, the bad, and the ugly stats for the Cost.

name: Midnight Wolf
text: Rush Outcast: Summon a copy of this.
flavor: Three of these would make for an EPIC T-shirt.

name: Sunspot Dragon
text: Tradeable, Lifesteal Quickdraw: Deal 6 damage.
flavor: THIS is why you shouldn't look directly at the sun.

name: The Badlands Bandits
text: Get eight 3/2 Bandits with Bonus Effects. Any that can't fit in your hand are summoned instead.
flavor: Bandits... ASSEMBLE!

name: Thirsty Drifter
text: Taunt Costs (1) less for each 1-Cost card you've played this game.
flavor: Quick! Someone bring her a Manathirst card!

name: Badlands Brawler
text: Battlecry: Start a Brawl! If you've Excavated twice, this always wins.
flavor: Watch out watch out watch out - R.K.O. outta nowhere!

name: Dragon Golem
text: Taunt Battlecry: Summon a copy of this for each Dragon in your hand.
flavor: I have a Dragon, I have a Golem. UH! Dragon Golem!

name: Giant Tumbleweed!!!
text: Deal 6 damage to all minions. Summon a 6/6 Tumbleweed.
flavor: Skarr's second-biggest hobby after laying waste to the Badlands is bowling.

name: Harrowing Ox
text: Taunt Battlecry: If you've Excavated twice, your next card this turn costs (7) less.
flavor: Dead or alive, you're pulling that plow.

name: Prismatic Beam
text: Deal 3 damage to all enemies. Costs (1) less for each enemy minion.
flavor: Seven colors of the rainbow, one for each enemy minion.

name: Skarr, the Catastrophe
text: Battlecry: Deal @ damage to all enemies (improved by each turn in a row you've played an Elemental).
flavor: We're not in Karazhan anymore, Reno.

name: Tram Conductor Gerry
text: Battlecry: If you've Excavated twice, summon six 3/3 Tram Cars with Rush.
flavor: His name is pronounced like 'gif'.

name: Triple Sevens
text: Deal 7 damage to a minion. Draw 7 cards.
flavor: If you count the 'seven' in the name, there's actually four total 7s, not three. Huge oversight from the designers.

name: Azerite Giant
text: Costs (1) less for each turn in a row you've played an Elemental.
flavor: Either that giant isn't really giant, or that doorway is HUGE!

name: Boomboss Tho'grun
text: Battlecry: Shuffle 3 T.N.T. into your opponent's deck. When drawn, blow up a card in their hand, deck, and board.
flavor: Ever since the Bloodrock Company hired this guy, business has been booming!

name: Elise, Badlands Savior
text: Battlecry: If your deck started with no duplicates, summon 5/5 copies of 4 random minions in your deck.
flavor: From the library to the field, she's proved herself to be a leading intellectual.

name: Reno, Lone Ranger
text: Battlecry: If your deck started with no duplicates, remove all enemy minions from the game.

name: Rheastrasza
text: Battlecry: If your deck started with no duplicates, summon the Purified Dragon Nest.
flavor: Rheastrasza ascends above loyalty to just her dragonflight to serve all dragonkind. She believes all flights deserve a future and will give her life for the future dragon prince.

name: Fye, the Setting Sun
text: Rush, Lifesteal, Taunt Costs (1) less for each Dragon you've summoned this game.
flavor: There is a dragon way down in Bloodrock They call the Setting Sun

name: Sunset Volley
text: Deal 10 damage randomly split among all enemies. Summon a random 10-Cost minion.
flavor: When the light is just right during Golden Hour, that is when you take out the selfie stick and start casting.

name: Walking Mountain
text: Rush, Lifesteal, Mega-Windfury Overload: (2)
flavor: The hills are alive with the sound of YEEEEHAAAWWWW!

name: Living Horizon
text: Taunt, Divine Shield Costs (1) less for each other card in your hand.
flavor: Even in the darkest of days, the sun never sets on the Badlands.

name: Reska, the Pit Boss
text: Rush. Costs (1) less for each minion that died this game. Deathrattle: Take control of a random enemy minion.
flavor: Overseer of the Bloodrock Mine, Reska will work you to the bone. They'll then reanimate your bones and work THOSE bones to the bone.

name: Burning Heart
text: Deal 2 damage to a minion. If it survives, give your hero +3 Attack this turn.
flavor: A 100% ethically sourced fire elemental heart is very hard to come by. This one definitely wasn't.

name: Fool's Gold
text: Get a random Golden Pirate and Elemental from other classes.
flavor: Worth its weight in rocks.

name: Shadestone Skulker
text: Rush. Battlecry: Take your weapon and gain its stats. Deathrattle: Give it back.
flavor: Sharing is caring - and they don't care.

name: Shimmer Shot
text: Deal 1 damage. Summon a random minion of that Cost.
flavor: I hope I don't jinx the outcome.

name: Soulfreeze
text: Freeze a minion and its neighbors. Deal damage to your hero equal to the number Frozen.
flavor: An effective way to freeze someone's soul is to just freeze their body.

name: Elementium Geode
text: Battlecry and Deathrattle: Draw a card. Deal 2 damage to your hero.
flavor: Elementium, my dear Geode.

name: Hidden Gem
text: Stealth At the end of your turn, restore 2 Health to all friendly characters.
flavor: This will be a staple in Unicorn Priest.

name: Mining Casualties
text: Summon two {0} Silver Hand Recruits with "Deathrattle: Summon a 1/1 Frail Ghoul".
flavor: They'll be fiiiiiiiiine.

name: Needlerock Totem
text: At the end of your turn, gain 2 Armor and draw a card.
flavor: You put the Needlerock in to get the Bloodrock out.

name: Quick Pick
text: After your hero attacks, draw a card.
flavor: QUICK! Pick which quick pick trick will stick in the thick of the wick! Lickety split!

name: Shale Spider
text: Battlecry: If you played an Elemental last turn, draw a card.
flavor: The 2nd member of the VERY exclusive Is-Called-A-Spider-But-Isn't-A-Beast Club.

name: Shroomscavate
text: Give a minion Divine Shield. Excavate a treasure.
flavor: As Globb shroominated on his situation, toiling endlessly in the mushroom mines, he came to the startling realization. His boss wasn't a very fun guy.

name: Elemental Companion
text: Summon a random Elemental Companion.
flavor: Always Hiffar.

name: Iridescent Gyreworm
text: Deathrattle: Give each of your minions a random Bonus Effect.
flavor: This card smells of iride.

name: Mismatched Fossils
text: Discover a Beast and an Undead. Swap their stats.
flavor: Whoever put these fossils together must be really careless.

name: Pendant of Earth
text: Discover a minion from your deck. Restore Health to your hero equal to its Cost.
flavor: Eaaaarrrrthhhhhh Pendaaaannnttttt Poweeerrrrrrrrrrr!!!!!!!!

name: Prosthetic Hand
text: Magnetic, Reborn Can Magnetize to Mechs or Undead.
flavor: It's creaky and it's rusty! It's spooky and it's dusty!

name: Sir Finley, the Intrepid
text: Battlecry: If you've Excavated twice, transform all enemy minions into 1/1 Murlocs.
flavor: And exactly how does Finley turn everyone into a murloc?

name: Summoning Ward
text: Secret: When your turn starts, summon a copy of your highest Cost minion.
flavor: You couldn't handle one Snowflipper Penguin. So what hope do you have… against two?!

name: Trogg Gemtosser
text: Finale: Deal 1 damage to a random enemy for each of your Mana Crystals.
flavor: Oh no! You're throwing valuable gems at me! Please stop!

name: Aftershocks
text: Deal 1 damage to all minions, three times. Costs (2) less if you cast a spell last turn.
flavor: They look shocked right now!

name: Crimson Expanse
text: Choose a damaged minion. Summon a copy of it that goes Dormant for one turn.
flavor: Idk. Looks pink to me.

name: Digging Straight Down
text: Deal 8 damage to a minion. Excavate a treasure.
flavor: You only make this mistake once.

name: Fel Fissure
text: Deal 2 damage to all minions. At the start of your next turn, deal 2 more damage to all minions.
flavor: This will clear the board, I'm fisSURE of it!

name: Fossilized Kaleidosaur
text: Battlecry: Gain two random Bonus Effects. Excavate a treasure.
flavor: He's not that bad if you don't die turn 4.

name: Gloomstone Guardian
text: Taunt. Choose One - Discard 2 cards; or Destroy one of your Mana Crystals. Forge: Do NEITHER.
flavor: From the same people who brought you Choose One, and Choose Twice, comes the exciting prequel: Choose NEITHER!

name: Glowstone Gyreworm
text: Lifesteal Quickdraw: Deal 5 damage. Forge: Change Quickdraw to Battlecry.
flavor: Believe it or not, this is Tram Conductor Gerry's Gyreworm. But is it pronounced Gerry's Gyreworm, Gerry's Gyreworm, Gerry's Gyreworm, or Gerry's Gyreworm?

name: Quartzite Crusher
text: Lifesteal. Freeze any character damaged by your hero.
flavor: It's not just a weapon… it's a rock!

name: Mantle Shaper
text: Costs (1) less for each spell you've cast while holding this.
flavor: You got a fireplace? I've got a guy who shapes mantles.

name: Shadow Word: Steal
text: Return an enemy minion to YOUR hand.
flavor: Anduin will literally take your stuff and say it's a Shadow Word.

name: Shattered Reflections
text: Choose a minion. Add a copy to your hand, deck, and battlefield.
flavor: Get mad at your mirror once, see Shattered Reflections forever :(

name: Chaos Creation
text: Deal 6 damage. Summon a random 6-Cost minion. Destroy the bottom 6 cards of your deck.
flavor: So THIS is who's been Greening everything!

name: Deepminer Brann
text: Battlecry: If your deck started with no duplicates, your Battlecries trigger twice for the rest of the game.
flavor: This is a very on-brannd effect.

name: Obsidian Revenant
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Summon two random Deathrattle minions that cost (3) or less.
flavor: What is this? A Reven for Ants?!

name: Stone Drake
text: Divine Shield, Taunt, Lifesteal, Elusive
flavor: "I am the great Stone Drake - good morning!"

name: Crystal Cluster
text: Gain three empty Mana Crystals. Any that can't fit summon a 3/7 Elemental with Taunt.
flavor: And if you can't fit any of the Elementals… do better.

name: Maruut Stonebinder
text: Battlecry: If your deck started with no duplicates, Discover an Elemental to summon. Add the others to your hand.
flavor: Savior of the World Pillar, Maruut valiantly fought the Twilight's Hammer to aid Therazane against the Cataclysm.

name: Therazane
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Double the stats of all Elementals in your hand and deck.
flavor: You thought we forgot about her, didn't you? *nervous laughter*

name: Anduin's Gift
text: Discover a Temporary Power Word: Shield, Shadow Word: Pain, or Mind Control.

name: Anduin's Gift
text: Discover a Temporary Power Word: Shield, Shadow Word: Pain, or Mind Control.
flavor: "My council assures me this is the perfect gift! Not that they needed to tell me. I know what's in there." -Anduin

name: Arthas's Gift
text: Discover a Temporary Dark Transformation, Howling Blast, or Death Strike.

flavor: Why aren't the bananas randomly split???

flavor: *gasp* So 7 DID eat 9!!

name: Sharp Shipment
text: Give your weapon +2/+2.
flavor: Pre-check is amazing these days. New rules say you don't have to take off your shoes, helmet, or daggers!

name: Trust Fall

flavor: Earthmother, catch me.

flavor: Our Un'Goro package includes the Tortollan travel tour! Just don't mind the Devilsaurs.

name: Vacation Planning

name: Carnivorous Cubicle
text: Battlecry: Destroy a friendly minion. Summon a copy of it at the end of your turns.
flavor: Hey, no eating at your desk!

name: Cash Cow

name: Spirit Peddler
text: Rush Deathrattle: Reduce the Cost of a random minion in your hand by (6).
flavor: *facepalm* I asked for an art piece of a ghost on a bicycle...

name: Travel Security
text: Taunt. Deathrattle: Summon a random 8-Cost minion.
flavor: "You're just gonna let ANY 8-Cost minion get past you!?" "...Yeah..."

name: Huddle Up
text: Fill your board with random Naga.
flavor: Spell, Naga, Naga, Naga, Naga, Naga, Naga, Naga...

name: Travelmaster Dungar

flavor: Our travel options will take you to Paradise and beyond!

name: Dispose of Evidence
text: Give your hero +3 Attack this turn. Pick from 3 cards in your hand to shuffle into your deck.
flavor: Just because you did it doesn't mean you have to be guilty.

name: Batty Guest
text: Deathrattle: Summon a 2/1 Bat.
flavor: His favorite food is chocolate cereal.

name: Call to the Stand
text: Your opponent summons a random minion from their hand.
flavor: Don't worry, there is a chair for you to sit in. It's very misleading.

name: Convincing Disguise

flavor: Okay gang, let's see who's really under the mask… *gasp* Old Man Bru'kan!?

name: Door of Shadows
text: Draw a spell. Infuse (@): Add a Temporary copy of it to your hand.
flavor: Upon arrival, please ring the doorbell of shadows, and wipe your shoes on the doormat of shadows before entering.

name: Dredger Staff
text: Battlecry: Give minions in your hand +1 Health.
flavor: The dredger staff held the dredger knife and said, "Dredger bow before the Sire!"

name: Flustered Librarian
text: Has +1 Attack for each Imp you control.
flavor: A fairly sIMPle card.

name: Planted Evidence
text: Discover a spell. It costs (2) less this turn.
flavor: So you're telling me this wasn't Natural Causes?

name: Promotion
text: Give a Silver Hand Recruit +3/+3 and Taunt.
flavor: And with the new title of 'Golden Hand Recruit', you also get a pay raise!

name: Relic of Extinction
text: Deal @ damage to a random enemy minion, twice. Improve your future Relics.
flavor: Faster than an asteroid, and just as effective.

name: Sinful Sous Chef
text: Deathrattle: Add 2 Silver Hand Recruits to your hand.
flavor: If this dinner party goes well, she thinks she has a good shot at being on Fel's Kitchen.

name: Sinstone Totem
text: At the end of your turn, gain +1 Health.
flavor: This one's heavier than the wooden totems. Mostly from the weight of your sins.

name: Suspicious Alchemist
text: Battlecry: Discover a spell. If your opponent guesses your choice, they get a copy.
flavor: Side effects may include feeling totally fine! Don't even worry about it.

name: Suspicious Usher
text: Battlecry: Discover a Legendary minion. If your opponent guesses your choice, they get a copy.
flavor: "Oh please, let me take your jacket, luggage, and absurdly large shoulder pads."

name: The Light! It Burns!
text: Deal damage to a minion equal to its Attack.
flavor: Wait, if you're over there, then who's messing with the lights?!

name: Theft Accusation
text: Choose a minion. Destroy it after you play a card copied from the opponent.
flavor: Honey, where are my paaaaaaants?

name: Totemic Evidence
text: Choose a basic Totem and summon it. Infuse (@ Totems): Summon all 4 instead.
flavor: Every totem is evidence of a tree's murder.

name: Anima Extractor
text: Whenever a friendly minion takes damage, give a random minion in your hand +1/+1.
flavor: After we are done you're welcome to help yourself to cookies and apple juice. Thank you for your donation!

name: Anonymous Informant
text: Battlecry: The next Secret you play costs (0).
flavor: It turns out she wasn't so great at keeping secrets after all.

name: Arson Accusation
text: Choose a minion. Destroy it after your hero takes damage.
flavor: We didn't start the fire!

name: Attorney-at-Maw
text: Choose One - Silence a minion; or Give a minion Immune this turn.
flavor: When the going gets tough, you don't want a criminal lawyer... you want a criminal lawyer...

name: Bibliomite
text: Battlecry: Choose a card in your hand to shuffle into your deck.
flavor: He did NOT want to cast a spell.

name: Carving Chisel
text: After your hero attacks, summon a random basic Totem.
flavor: Look at your stone. Visualize the totem within. Then gently...

name: Castle Kennels
text: Give a friendly minion +2 Attack. If it's a Beast, give it Rush.
flavor: Play dead! Oh…

name: Class Action Lawyer
text: Battlecry: If your deck has no Neutral cards, set a minion's stats to 1/1.
flavor: "Have you or a loved one ever been injured in a Consecration?"

name: Conqueror's Banner
text: Reveal a card from each player's deck, three times. Draw any of yours that cost more.
flavor: Olgra, I love your new tapestry! Where did you get it?

name: Crazed Wretch
text: Has +2 Attack and Charge while damaged.
flavor: Enrage is all the rage.

name: Crooked Cook
text: At the end of your turn, if you dealt 3 or more damage to the enemy hero, draw a card.
flavor: There are many things not called poison which can kill a man. But in this case, it is poison.

name: Double Cross
text: Secret: When your opponent spends all their Mana, draw two cards.
flavor: Valeera revealed herself to be a double agent. At which point Maiev felt comfortable revealing that she also was a double agent. And then Scabbs announced to everybody that - get this - he was a double agent.

name: Frenzied Fangs
text: Summon two 2/1 Bats. Infuse (@): Give them +1/+2.
flavor: That's one stylish bat.

name: Frozen Touch
text: Deal 3 damage. Infuse (@): Add a Frozen Touch to your hand.
flavor: Is this what Bob was talking about when he said he served a drink to a Death Knight once?

name: Great Hall
text: Set a minion's Attack and Health to 3.
flavor: It's fabulous! It's grand! It's, well it's really very nice.

name: Imp-oster
text: Battlecry: Choose a friendly Imp. Transform into a copy of it.
flavor: There is an imposter among us.

name: Impending Catastrophe
text: Draw a card. Repeat for each Imp you control.
flavor: The imps end you, and the cats... well, they astrophe.

name: Kidnap
text: Secret: After your opponent plays a minion, stuff it in a 0/4 Sack.
flavor: Check your coat, but don't check the coat closet.

name: Maze Guide
text: Battlecry: Summon a random 2-Cost minion.
flavor: "And if you look to your left, you'll see an even larger statue of Sire Denathrius!"

name: Motion Denied
text: Secret: After your opponent plays three cards in a turn, deal 6 damage to the enemy hero.
flavor: DO NOT PASS GO. DO NOT COLLECT 200 GOLD.

name: Murder Accusation
text: Choose a minion. Destroy it after another enemy minion dies.
flavor: Quote From Man Murdered: "What are you gonna do, murder me?"

name: Mysterious Visitor
text: Battlecry: Reduce the Cost of cards copied from your opponent by (3).
flavor: Dave, we can tell this letter is fake - it's in your handwriting. And take off that stupid hood, you're embarrassing us.

name: Natural Causes
text: Deal 2 damage. Summon a 2/2 Treant.
flavor: What if the suspect was framed? What if the murder weapon was... a plant?

name: Perjury
text: Secret: When your turn starts, Discover and cast a Secret from another class.
flavor: By Liar be Perjured!

name: Priest of the Deceased
text: Taunt Infuse (@): Gain +2/+2.
flavor: "Funnel cakes? I haven't had those in years…"

name: Relic Vault
text: The next Relic you play this turn casts twice.
flavor: Holds Sire Denathrius' most prized possession - his teddy bear, Jeremy Bearimy.

name: Riot!
text: Your minions can't be reduced below 1 Health this turn. They each attack a random enemy minion.
flavor: No, Blizzard!

name: Roosting Gargoyle
text: Battlecry: Give a friendly Beast +2 Attack.
flavor: Jalapeñas!

name: Serrated Bone Spike
text: Deal 3 damage to a minion. If it dies, your next card this turn costs (2) less.
flavor: Draka, in an attempt to help, threw them a bone.

name: Sinful Brand
text: Brand an enemy minion. Whenever it takes damage, deal 1 damage to the enemy hero.
flavor: My brand!

name: Sketchy Stranger
text: Battlecry: Discover a Secret from another class.
flavor: More of a 'Painted Stranger' if you ask me.

name: Spirit Poacher
text: Battlecry: Summon a random Dormant Wildseed.
flavor: Always poach from your local spirit shelter.

name: Sticky Situation
text: Secret: After your opponent casts a spell, summon a 3/4 Spider with Stealth.
flavor: "Now this is what I'd call..." "...just shut up."

name: Vile Library
text: Give a friendly minion +1/+1. Repeat for each Imp you control.
flavor: What type of vial library has 0 vials in it!?

name: Volatile Skeleton
text: Deathrattle: Deal 2 damage to a random enemy.
flavor: These ice sculpures look so realistic!

name: Afterlife Attendant
text: Your Infuse cards also Infuse while in your deck.
flavor: AH! Wrist cramp!

name: Ashen Elemental
text: Battlecry: Whenever your opponent draws a card next turn, they take 2 damage.
flavor: "The castle was nice but the fireplaces were too small - 2/5 stars"

name: Cathedral of Atonement
text: Give a minion +2/+1 and draw a card.
flavor: You'll actually find more than one tonement here.

name: Clear Conscience
text: Give a friendly minion +2/+3 and "Elusive on your opponent's turn."
flavor: Do you swear to give the buff, the whole buff, and nothing but the buff, so help you Kyrestia?

name: Creepy Painting
text: After another minion dies, become a copy of it.
flavor: I do not like this painting, Harth. Its smug aura mocks me.

name: Dinner Performer
text: Battlecry: Summon a random minion from your deck that you can afford to play.
flavor: BANG!

name: Forensic Duster
text: Battlecry: Your opponent's minions cost (1) more next turn.
flavor: He had plenty of experience with dusting things from his time as a butler, so when a murder was committed he saw a real job opportunity!

name: Framester
text: Battlecry: Shuffle 3 'Framed' cards into the opponent's deck. When drawn, they Overload for (2).
flavor: "Who put these beans in my pocket?!" -Man With Beans in Pocket

name: Ghastly Gravedigger
text: Battlecry: If you control a Secret, choose a card in your opponent's hand to shuffle into their deck.

text: Discover a friendly minion to resurrect and give it Rush. It dies at the end of turn.
flavor: Whoops, typo!

name: Hedge Maze
text: Trigger a friendly minion's Deathrattle.

name: Identity Theft
text: Discover a copy of a card from your opponent's hand and deck.

text: After your hero attacks, give your damaged minions +1/+2. Infuse (@): +2/+2 instead.

name: Incarceration

name: Invitation Courier

name: Jury Duty
text: Summon two Silver Hand Recruits. Give your Silver Hand Recruits +1/+1.

name: Magnifying Glaive
text: After your hero attacks, draw until you have 3 cards.
flavor: Vengeance!

name: Muckborn Servant
text: Taunt Battlecry: Discover a Paladin card.
flavor: Party guests never tip as well as the patrons in Bob's tavern.

name: Murloc Holmes
text: Battlecry: Solve 3 Clues about your opponent's cards to get copies of them.

name: Nexus-Prince Shaffar
text: Spellburst: Give a minion in your hand +3/+3 and this Spellburst (unless it already has these effects).
flavor: Whatever you do, do not give him OR his ethereal parrot a magical lamp.

text: Freeze a minion. Summon a 2/2 Volatile Skeleton.

name: Objection!
text: Secret: When your opponent plays a minion, Counter it.
flavor: "Sire, this is a Sindy's."

text: At the end of your turn, summon a random basic Totem. Infuse (@): Summon two instead.

name: Pelagos
text: After you cast a spell on a friendly minion, set its Attack and Health to the higher of the two.

text: Summon two 2/2 Treants. Infuse (@): Two 5/5 Ancients instead.

name: Primordial Wave

text: Discover a Class card from your deck and draw all copies of it.

name: Shadowborn

text: Deal 3 damage. Summon a random Dormant Wildseed.

name: Tight-Lipped Witness

name: Vengeful Visage
text: Secret: After an enemy minion attacks your hero, summon a copy of it to attack the enemy hero.

name: Weapons Expert
text: Battlecry: If you have a weapon equipped, give it +1/+1. Otherwise, draw a weapon.

name: Wild Spirits

name: Boon of the Ascended

name: Cold Case
text: Summon two 2/2 Volatile Skeletons. Gain 4 Armor.
flavor: And that's why you keep your skeletons in your closet instead of your freezer.

name: Crud Caretaker
text: Battlecry: Summon a 3/5 Elemental with Taunt.

name: Dew Process
text: For the rest of the game, players draw an extra card at the start of their turn.

name: Dispossessed Soul
text: Battlecry: If you control a location, Discover a copy of a card in your deck.

name: Incriminating Psychic

name: Kryxis the Voracious
text: Battlecry: Discard your hand. Deathrattle: Draw 3 cards.

name: Life Sentence
text: Remove a minion from the game.
flavor: Also sentenced to laugh and love.

name: Mischievous Imp
text: Battlecry: Summon a copy of this. Infuse (@): Summon two copies instead.

name: Murlocula
text: Lifesteal Infuse (@): This costs (0).

name: Order in the Court
text: Reorder your deck from highest Cost to lowest Cost. Draw a card.

name: Orion, Mansion Manager
text: After a friendly Secret is revealed, cast a different Mage Secret and gain +2/+2.

name: Partner in Crime
text: Battlecry: Summon a copy of this minion at the end of your turn.
flavor: "You know what we need? Some rope." "That's stupid. Name one thing you'd need a rope for."

name: Private Eye
text: Battlecry: Cast a Secret from your deck. Combo: Cast 2 instead.

name: Prosecutor Mel'tranix
text: Battlecry: Your opponent can only play their left- and right-most cards on their next turn.

name: Scuttlebutt Ghoul
text: Taunt Battlecry: If you control a Secret, summon a copy of this.
flavor: No 'if's, 'and's, or 'scuttlebutt's'!

name: Sightless Magistrate
text: Battlecry: Both players draw until they have 5 cards.
flavor: Does "Justice is Blind" still apply with Spectral Sight?

name: Stonebound Gargon
text: Rush Infuse (@): Also damages the minions next to whomever this attacks.
flavor: Really good at "stay."

name: The Stonewright
text: Battlecry: For the rest of the game, your Totems have +2 Attack.
flavor: She wrights stone better than she reads it.

name: Widowbloom Seedsman
text: Battlecry: Draw a Nature spell. Gain an empty Mana Crystal.
flavor: Sometimes a blue thumb is better than a green one.

name: All Fel Breaks Loose
text: Summon a friendly Demon that died this game. Infuse (@ Demons): Summon three instead.
flavor: Maybe we should have made the bars closer together…

name: Ara'lon
text: Battlecry: Summon one of each Dormant Wildseed.
flavor: If I had a nickel for every time a Hunter Legendary minion in Castle Nathria summoned three different companions, I'd have two nickels - which isn't a lot, but it's weird that it happened twice.

name: Clean the Scene
text: Destroy all minions with 3 or less Attack. Infuse (@): 6 or less.
flavor: Not even the holy Light can get anima out of white silk.

name: Death Blossom Whomper
text: Battlecry: Draw a Deathrattle minion and gain its Deathrattle.

name: Elitist Snob
text: Battlecry: For each Paladin card in your hand, randomly gain Divine Shield, Lifesteal, Rush, or Taunt.
flavor: "I heard the Sire invited a Murloc! How dreadful!"

name: Famished Fool
text: Battlecry: Draw a card. Infuse (@): Draw 3 instead.

name: Lady Darkvein

name: Muck Plumber
text: ALL minions cost (2) more.
flavor: If you drink muck, you go to the Maw before you die.

name: Necrolord Draka
text: Battlecry: Equip a @/3 Dagger. (+1 Attack for each other card you played this turn, up to 10!)
flavor: We originally planned on giving Rogue a Legendary minion called "The Moon", but SOMEONE jumped in the frame.

name: Relic of Dimensions
text: Draw two cards and reduce their Cost by (@). Improve your future Relics.
flavor: A glaive is a glaive, but a mystery box could be anything! It could even be a glaive!

name: Shadehound
text: Whenever this attacks, give your other Beasts +2/+2. Infuse (@ Beasts): Gain Rush.
flavor: This Shadehound wasn't just a good boy. He was the best.

name: Shadow Waltz
text: Summon a 3/5 Shadow with Taunt. If a minion died this turn, summon another.
flavor: They're dancing to one of Rin's demonic symphonies. Her music might not be famous now, but just you wait!

name: Sinrunner
text: Deathrattle: Destroy a random enemy minion.
flavor: Blanchy was said to be an affectionate and well-behaved horse in life. How she ended up in Revendreth? We're too afraid to ask.

name: Soul Seeker
text: Battlecry: Swap this with a random minion from your opponent's deck.
flavor: The Soul Seeker's job is to look for a snitch.

name: Steamcleaner
text: Battlecry: Destroy ALL cards in both players' decks that didn't start there.

name: Stoneborn Accuser
text: Infuse (@): Gain "Battlecry: Deal 5 damage."
flavor: "I SAW THEM VENT, I SWEAR!"

name: Bog Beast
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Summon a 2/4 Muckmare with Taunt.

name: Contract Conjurer
text: Costs (3) less for each Secret you control.
flavor: This document looks illegally binding.

name: Deathborne
text: Deal 2 damage to all minions. Summon a 2/2 Volatile Skeleton for each killed.

name: Decimator Olgra
text: Battlecry: Gain +1/+1 for each damaged minion, then attack all enemies.

name: Defense Attorney Nathanos

name: Imp King Rafaam
text: Battlecry: Resurrect four friendly Imps. Infuse (@): Give your Imps +2/+2.

name: Masked Reveler
text: Rush Deathrattle: Summon a 2/2 copy of another minion in your deck.
flavor: "It's party time! P-A-R-T-Why? Because I gotta!"

name: Scribbling Stenographer
text: Rush. Costs (1) less for each card you've played this turn.
flavor: A truly staggering 180 scribbles per minute!

name: Sylvanas, the Accused
text: Battlecry: Destroy an enemy minion. Infuse (@): Take control of it instead.
flavor: Turns into 'Sylvanas, the Infused'.

name: Theotar, the Mad Duke
text: Battlecry: Discover a card in each player's hand and swap them.
flavor: "I'm afraid you've gone mad! You're entirely bonkers. But I'll tell you a secret. All the best souls are."

name: Tome Tampering
text: Shuffle 1-Cost copies of cards in your hand into your deck, then discard your hand.
flavor: An overdue book calls for a do-over.

name: Divine Toll

name: Huntsman Altimor

name: Red Herring
text: Taunt Your non-Red Herring minions have Stealth.

name: Remornia, Living Blade

name: Sinfueled Golem

flavor: Originally devoted to snuffing out the Titans' influence, Shadowflame has twisted Fyrakk's mind into an abyss of malice. His Dreamrender now only hungers for a world of embers.

name: Dissolving Ooze
text: Battlecry: Destroy a friendly minion. Spit out the Bones of its Attack and Health into your hand.
flavor: Ooze Ooz Oo O

name: Sharp-Eyed Lookout
text: Battlecry: Draw a card. It costs (1) less this turn. (I know its name!)@Battlecry: Draw a card. It costs (1) less this turn. (It's {5}!)
flavor: "It's a bird! It's a bird! It's a bird!"

name: Blob of Tar
text: Poisonous, Taunt Deathrattle: Summon a 2/2 Blob with Poisonous and a 2/2 Blob with Taunt.
flavor: A tar is born.

name: Endbringer Umbra
text: Battlecry: Trigger the Deathrattles of 5 friendly minions that died this game.
flavor: After many years of exile, Umbra is so close to returning to her city. When she arrives, she will make sure the Tortollans get what they deserve...

name: Cursed Catacombs
text: Discover another card from your deck. Make it Temporary.
flavor: The minion is now permanently cursed. Temporarily.

name: Bloodpetal Biome
text: Discover a Temporary 1-Cost minion.
flavor: The rash doesn't FEEL temporary.

name: Crypt Map
text: Discover a Frost Rune card. If you play it this turn, also pick one of the others.
flavor: Solving a maze is easy. Just hug the left wall and don't get eaten by dinosaurs!

name: Dive the Golakka Depths
text: Repeatable Quest: Summon 6 Murlocs. Reward: Murlocs you summon gain +1/+1.
flavor: Day 5. Elise had a hunch that the Lost City may be hidden deep beneath the Golakka Hot Springs. Niri swam down and discovered a beautiful cavern! The Murlocs may not be hiding an entrance to the city, but it seems they do have a few secrets.

name: Enter the Lost City
text: Quest: Survive 10 turns. Reward: Latorvius, Gaze of the City.
flavor: Day 8. We’ve done it! As night fell, we came upon a brilliantly glowing tunnel guarded by two slumbering Tol’vir. With silent footsteps, we walked through and emerged into the heart of the Lost City! I’m sure my people will welcome us with open arms.

name: Escape the Underfel
text: Quest: Play 6 Temporary cards. Reward: Underfel Rift.
flavor: Day 7. A terrible day! The ground opened beneath us, and we fell head over shell into an accursed rift! Fel choked my keen senses, and demonic beasts emerged from the fog. Thank goodness Umbra was able to use her magic to ward them off while we escaped.

name: Glade Ecologist
text: Deathrattle: Get a 1-Cost Holy spell that gives a minion +2 or -2 Health.
flavor: The dude minored in Underfel Biology. Now that's a renaissance Tortollan!

name: Hive Map
text: Discover a Fel spell. If you play it this turn, also pick one of the others.
flavor: The perfect map of where to never ever ever ever ever go.

name: Knockback
text: Deal @ damage to a minion (improved for each time you've shuffled cards into your deck).
flavor: Every day he's scufflin'

name: Lie in Wait
text: Quest: Shuffle cards into your deck, 5 times. Reward: Master Dusk.
flavor: Day 2. Our first night in the Crater was a tad rough on this old shell. I can’t shake the feeling that we’re being watched. I swear I saw a glint of shining silver in the dark. I was going to ask Umbra about it at breakfast, but she never turned up.

name: Life Cycle
text: Destroy a minion. Summon a random minion of the same Cost to replace it.
flavor: It's the cyyyyyycle of liiiiiife.

name: Merchant of Legend
text: Battlecry: Discover a Legendary minion. Shuffle the other two into your deck.
flavor: "Tortollan has knives if you have coin."

name: Mountain Map
text: Discover a minion with a type you haven't played. If you play it this turn, also pick one of the others.
flavor: See that part at the top? That's the top.

name: Odd Map
text: Discover an odd-Attack Beast. If you play it this turn, also pick one of the others.
flavor: I don't EVEN know where this goes!

name: Platysaur
text: Battlecry: Draw a card. Deathrattle: Discard it.
flavor: "Yup yup yup!"

name: Reach Equilibrium
text: Quest: Cast 4 Holy spells Reward: Life's Breath. Quest: Cast 4 Shadow spells. Reward: Death's Touch.
flavor: Day 6. Today we found ourselves in a glade tormented by conflicting Holy and Shadow magic. At its center were two enormous Elementals, like opposite sides of the same coin. I hope one day we'll return here to see this broken place restored to peace.

name: Reanimate the Terror
text: Quest: Spend 15 Corpses. Reward: Tyrax, Bone Terror.
flavor: Day 11. We’ve been betrayed! Umbra has been meeting secretly with the Cult of the Damned to plan a coup. She and High Cultist Herenn used shadow magic to raise an undead dinosaur army! Tortolla preserve us, the fate of the Lost City rests in our hands.

name: Restore the Wild
text: Quest: Fill your board on 3 of your turns. Reward: The Everbloom.
flavor: Day 3. We happened upon a clearing filled with dangerous Bloodpetals. As I was noting our findings, the world went dark. My vision is perfect of course, but it appeared as though a large flying shape was blocking out the sun! Confounding indeed.

name: Scrappy Scavenger
text: Battlecry: Discover a card with Cost equal to your remaining Mana Crystals.
flavor: "One second, I'm stashing this Ultragigasaur in my little satchel."

name: Sizzling Cinder
text: Deathrattle: Deal 2 damage randomly split among all enemies.
flavor: "Hey, I'm sizzlin' here!"

name: Spirit of the Mountain
text: Quest: Play 6 minions of unique types. Reward: Ashalon.
flavor: Day 10. A Tortollan named Bralma took Niri, Elise, and I deep into the mountain. She showed us how the Tortollans move lava up from the base of the volcano through a system of “lavaqueducts.” I was shocked to find a pack of Volcanosaurs living there!

name: Submerged Map
text: Discover a Murloc. If you play it this turn, also pick one of the others.
flavor: Sure, it leads straight to Latorvia. How long can you hold your breath?

name: The Food Chain
text: Quest: Play a 1, 3, 5, and 7-Attack Beast. Reward: Shokk.
flavor: Day 1. The search begins! I joined Elise Starseeker at the outskirts of the Crater, as well as a Tortollan named Umbra and a most curious gnome named Niri. Embarking into the jungle, we stumbled upon the largest tracks I’ve ever laid eyes on!

name: The Forbidden Sequence
text: Quest: Discover 7 cards. Reward: The Origin Stone.
flavor: Day 9. We were not welcomed with open arms, but with spears! Fortunately, Chief Esho took pity on us and called off the guards. Learning of Elise's expertise, a Titanographer whisked her away to the library. Umbra disappeared in the twisting streets...

name: Unleash the Colossus
text: Quest: Deal exactly 2 damage to an enemy on your turn, 12 times. Reward: Gorishi Colossus.
flavor: Day 4. I am dismayed to report that we thought we'd found a hidden entrance to the Lost City, but in fact it was a Silithid Hive! We high-tailed it out of there faster than a goblin wearing rocket boots. I am not terribly fond of bugs.

name: Ancient Raptor
text: Battlecry: Choose to gain +3 Attack, Divine Shield, or "Deathrattle: Summon two 1/1 Plants."
flavor: It prefers "Experienced."

name: Cinderfin
text: Deathrattle: Summon a 2/1 Sizzling Cinder.
flavor: "Don't play with fire." "But they're my friends!"

name: Cower in Fear
text: Deal 3 damage to a minion. The next Beast you play this turn costs (2) less.
flavor: Mother Duck's fourth duckling got lost in Un'Goro Crater.

name: Crystal Tender
text: Tradeable Battlecry: Gain empty Mana Crystals until both players have the same Mana.
flavor: "Hands off my tendies!"

name: Cultist Map
text: Discover a card from your deck. If you play it this turn, also pick one of the others.
flavor: Are the Shrouded Shells actually great trackers, or are the Cult of the Damned just REALLY bad about leaving secret maps lying around?

name: Curious Explorer
text: Deathrattle: Reduce the Cost of a minion in your opponent's hand by (2).
flavor: "Wow, this flower's mouth is perfectly head-shaped."

name: Dinositter
text: At the end of your turn, reduce the Cost of a random Beast in your hand by (1).
flavor: "You aren't leaving this log until you finish your greens."

name: Eyes in the Sky
text: Battlecry: Look at 3 cards in your enemy's deck. Pick one to put on top.
flavor: "I got eyes on Umbra's unstoppable undead army. I'll uh... stay wayyy up here."

name: Fumigate
text: Deal 3 damage to a minion and all others of the same minion type.
flavor: Stink bomb go!

name: Infestation
text: Get two 1-Cost Gorishi Stingers. Each one deals 2 damage and summons a 2/1 Grub with Rush.
flavor: NOT THE WASPS!

name: Interrogation
text: Shuffle three 3/3 Ninjas with Stealth into your deck that are Summoned When Drawn.
flavor: "Spill the tea or I'll end your entire career, sis."

name: Questing Assistant
text: Battlecry: If you played a Quest this game, deal 3 damage to an enemy minion.
flavor: Forget the Quest. Our new Quest is to make sure no harm ever comes to him.

name: Ravenous Flock
text: At the start of your next turn, summon three 2/1 Hatchlings.
flavor: It's a flock of screamgulls!

name: Rockskipper
text: Battlecry: Get a 1-Cost Rock that deals 3 damage.
flavor: Don't step on a stream or you'll break your mama's spleen.

name: Spelunker
text: Battlecry: Your next Temporary card costs (2) less.
flavor: Echo... echo... repeatable this turn...

name: Stonecarver
text: At the end of your turn, give another friendly damaged minion +2/+2.
flavor: *clink* *clink* *clink* *"D'oh!"

name: Story of Barnabus
text: Draw a minion. If it has 5 or more Attack, give it +5 Health and gain 5 Armor.
flavor: "Once there was a giant dinosaur. He was so giant that everyone died. The end."

name: Story of Carnassa
text: Shuffle ten 1-Cost 3/2 Raptors into your deck with "Battlecry: Draw a card."
flavor: "... and ALL TEN Raptors were at the top of the deck!"

name: Story of Galvadon
text: Give a minion three random Bonus Effects.
flavor: "...so I gave him +12 Attack and Windfury -- and you won't believe this -- he LIVED."

name: Story of the Waygate
text: Reduce the Cost of cards in your hand that didn't start in your deck by (1).
flavor: "...and then a lot of people got mad."

name: Tortollan Storyteller
text: At the end of your turn, give +1/+1 to each friendly minion of a different type.
flavor: "And then a turtle made it to the water!"

name: Unearthed Artifacts
text: Summon a random 2-Cost minion. If you've Discovered this turn, summon a random 4-Cost minion instead.
flavor: The Tortollans live so long they're unearthing their OWN artifacts!

name: Violet Treasuregill
text: Battlecry: Cast a random spell from your deck that costs (2) or less (targets this if possible).
flavor: His brother Violent was banned from the colony.

name: Ambush Predators
text: Summon a 1/1 Spitter with Stealth and Poisonous. Kindred: Do it again.
flavor: Ah, no wonder YOU'RE extinct.

name: Ancient Stegodon
text: Battlecry: Choose to gain Taunt, Poisonous, or +1/+1.
flavor: I'm 30 years old.

name: Archaios
text: Whenever another friendly minion attacks, set its Health equal to this minion's Health.
flavor: She's a health influencer.

name: Axe of the Forefathers
text: After your hero attacks, deal 1 damage to all minions.
flavor: ...and the axe of the beforefathers before the forefathers before him.

name: Bralma Searstone
text: Your Elementals deal 1 extra damage.
flavor: She makes a mean molten lava cake.

name: Cloud Serpent
text: Battlecry: Get a copy of another Elemental or Dragon in your hand.
flavor: Cloudy with a chance of Quest Rewards.

name: Conjured Bookkeeper
text: Deathrattle: Draw a spell. Kindred: Summon a copy of this.
flavor: In charge of cleaning up after the Library Rager.

name: Flight of the Firehawk
text: Draw two minions of different minion types. Give them +1/+1.
flavor: Also the name of a famous Tortollan orchestral arrangement.

name: Fortify
text: Gain 3 Armor. Deal damage equal to your Armor to an enemy minion.
flavor: With vitamins and minerals!

name: Gorishi Tunneler
text: Stealth After this attacks, deal 2 damage to the enemy hero.
flavor: "This card is really boring." "Nah, I really dig this card."

name: Grazing Stegodon
text: At the end of your turn, gain +1 Attack (even while in hand or deck).
flavor: He's a growing boy. :)

name: Hatchery Helper
text: Battlecry: Give your other minions with 2 or less Attack +1/+1 and Taunt.
flavor: Yeah, painting patterns on the eggs is SUPER helpful J'an.

name: Hot Spring Glider
text: Battlecry: Your next Murloc costs (1) less. Kindred: And gains Divine Shield.
flavor: It's an important survival instinct to keep a low profile in Un'Goro Crater. Gargl will not survive long.

name: Insect Claw
text: After your hero attacks, summon a 2/1 Grub with Rush.
flavor: Get your grubby claws off me!

name: Latorvian Armorer
text: Battlecry: Deal 2 damage to an enemy minion. If it dies, gain 5 Armor.
flavor: All it needs now is a nice coat of blue paint!

name: Lava Flow
text: Deal 2 damage to the lowest Health enemy, three times. Overload: (1)
flavor: The lava must flow.

name: Marshland Thresher
text: After you cast a spell, gain Divine Shield.
flavor: "Just remember, when we pose for pictures, look very shadowy and grainy."

name: Niri of the Crater
text: Whenever you play a 1-Cost minion, double its stats. Whenever you cast a 1-Cost spell, cast it twice.
flavor: Niri, Niri, Niri of the Crater, strong as they can be! HAAAAAEEHOOOOHEHOOOEAAAAAAAA!!!! Watch out for that tree!

name: Paleomancy
text: Discover an Undead. Spend 5 Corpses to keep all 3 instead.
flavor: Death finds a way.

name: Petrified Ogre
text: Starts Dormant. While Dormant, gain +2/+2 at the start of your turn. (50% chance to awaken instead.)
flavor: First, he was afraid...

name: Primalfin Challenger
text: Battlecry: Your next Kindred triggers twice.
flavor: "MURGRGLGLLGLLRRRG!!!!!!" There were no survivors.

name: Pterrordax Egg
text: Deathrattle: Summon a 3/3 Pterrordax that steals 1 Health from all other minions.
flavor: When you crack this egg, it cracks you right back.

name: Ready the Fleet
text: Give +1/+2 to a friendly minion and your other minions that share a type with it.
flavor: The Fleet is on fleek.

name: Relic Miner
text: Battlecry: Destroy the top card of your deck. Discover a card of the same Rarity.
flavor: "I struck gold! NOOOOOOOO!"

name: Reluctant Wrangler
text: Reborn Deathrattle: Summon a 2/2 Undead Beast with Taunt.
flavor: "It's not that I never wanted a pet. I didn't want THIS pet."

name: Skyscreamer Eggs
text: Deathrattle: Summon four 2/1 Hatchlings.
flavor: Aaaaaaaaaaahmlette

name: Storage Scuffle
text: Deal 3 damage to a minion. Costs (0) if you've Discovered this turn.
flavor: Flip and file! Mix and shuffle! Sort and swap! Do the Storage Scuffle!

name: Stranglevine
text: Deathrattle: Give a random friendly minion a random Bonus Effect and this Deathrattle.
flavor: "Wow, this human's head is perfectly mouth-shaped."

name: Tunnel Terror
text: Deathrattle: Get two random Temporary 2-Cost minions.
flavor: And a tiny soul patch to match.

name: Twilight Mender
text: Deathrattle: Get a random Holy and Shadow spell.
flavor: The Gravedawn Glade is FULL of indecisive Priests.

name: Undercover Cultist
text: Taunt, Reborn Has +3 Attack while damaged.
flavor: Don't be suspicious, don't be suspicious.

name: Vault Breaker
text: After you Discover a card, reduce its Cost by (1).
flavor: I've already told him 3 times to PUSH.

name: Volcanic Thrasher
text: Battlecry: Draw a Fire spell. Kindred: Give it Spell Damage +2.
flavor: Very friendly, but be careful when it asks to play fetch.

name: Ancient Pterrordax
text: Battlecry: Choose to gain Stealth until your next turn, Elusive, or Windfury.
flavor: What's that sound? He's a terrible conductor.

name: Bugsquasher
text: Battlecry: Deal 6 damage to an enemy minion with a minion type.
flavor: The Tortollans would be nothing without their QA department.

name: Caustic Fumes
text: Destroy an enemy minion. Kindred: Deal 2 damage to all minions.
flavor: If the fumes don't get them, the fumes might.

name: City Defenses
text: Summon two 0/6 Security with Taunt. They gain +1 Attack when damaged.
flavor: These 0/6 Taunts have kept invaders out for centuries.

name: Crater Gator
text: Battlecry: Until the start of your next turn, the enemy hero can't be healed.
flavor: See ya later Crater Gator!

name: Creature of the Sacred Cave
text: At the end of your turn, recast a random Holy spell you cast this turn (targets this if possible).
flavor: Really likes being read to.

name: Cryosleep
text: Deal 4 damage and draw a card. Kindred: Draw another.
flavor: You mad? Cryobout it.

name: Dread Raptor
text: Battlecry: Draw a Deathrattle minion that costs (3) or less. Kindred: It costs (0).
flavor: "I AM THE CLAW!"

name: Elise the Navigator
text: Battlecry: If your deck started with 10 cards of different Costs, craft a custom location.
flavor: "I've seen that stump before. We must be getting close!"

name: Eternal Bloodpetal
text: Deathrattle: Summon a 0/1 Eternal Seedling.
flavor: The crab grass of Un'Goro.

name: Gravedawn Sunbloom
text: Draw 2 cards. Kindred: This costs (2) less.
flavor: So holy it photosynthesizes itself!

name: Gravedawn Voidbulb
text: Summon a random 4-Cost minion and give it Taunt. Kindred: Do it again.
flavor: How many Gravedawns does it take to screw in a Voidbulb?

name: Ido of the Threshfleet
text: While this is alive, you get a 2-Cost Holy spell that gives a minion +2/+2 and Divine Shield.
flavor: Ido, therefore I am.

name: Mechanized Magma
text: Whenever you play a Fire spell, gain stats equal to its Cost.
flavor: Its volcanic strength powers its mechanical arm... and also its normal arm.

name: Neferset Weaponsmith
text: Battlecry: Get a random weapon from another class. Combo: Give it +2 Attack.
flavor: Neferset your drink on the table without a coaster.

name: Primal Sabretooth
text: Stealth After this attacks and kills a minion, get a copy of it.
flavor: 100 dino birds versus 1 sabretooth. Who would win?

name: Ravasaur Matriarch
text: Kindred: Deal damage to an enemy minion equal to this minion's Attack.
flavor: The female Ravasaur is 30% larger than the male. And 100% more aggressive.

name: Razidir
text: Battlecry: Discard a random card from your hand. Kindred: Your opponent's hand instead.
flavor: Be prepaaaaaaaaared! (by playing a Demon or Beast the previous turn.)

name: Shellnado
text: Spend up to 5 Armor. For each spent, deal 1 damage to all minions.
flavor: Spin to win!

name: Steamfin Thief
text: Kindred: Summon two 1/1 Murlocs with Rush.
flavor: Dial M for Murlocs.

name: Torga
text: Battlecry: Draw a Kindred card and another card that activates it.
flavor: Torga was killed, eaten, used to summon the undead and then used as a loudspeaker for spirits. But at least he's got a hell of a story to tell.

name: Wave of Tar
text: Deal 2 damage to all enemy minions. Enemy minions cost (2) more next turn.
flavor: "Watch out for my WAVE OF TAR!!! Just... stand still for a minute."

name: Willful Watcher
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Destroy the top 3 cards of your deck.
flavor: I still don't know why he has a sword. Despite being in many battles, he really just watches.

name: Windswept Pageturner
text: After you summon an Elemental, deal 3 damage to a random enemy.
flavor: This story will blow you away.

name: Gorishi Wasp
text: Rush. Whenever this takes damage, get a 1-Cost Gorishi Stinger.
flavor: This card is the wasp's elbows!

name: Hybridization
text: Draw a 1, 2, 3, and 4-Cost minion. Kindred: They cost (1) less.
flavor: You take the blue flower -- the story ends, you wake up in the inn and believe whatever you want to believe. You take the red flower -- you stay in Un'Goro, and I show you how deep the Gorishi tunnel goes.

name: Reanimated Pterrordax
text: Rush, Lifesteal Costs Corpses instead of Mana.
flavor: Ptruly pterrifying.

name: Silithid Queen
text: Rush Kindred: Give your hero +5 Attack this turn.
flavor: Yaaaaaaass Silithid Queen, stiiiing.

name: Slagclaw
text: Battlecry: Summon two 2/1 Sizzling Cinders. Kindred: Trigger your Sizzling Cinders' Deathrattles.
flavor: You can't just have the sizzle, you gotta have the cinders.

name: Stormbrewer
text: Whenever this attacks, deal 3 damage to the target first. Kindred: Gain Rush.
flavor: It was a dark and stormy Elemental...

name: Story of Sulfuras
text: Swap your Hero Power to "Deal 8 damage to a random enemy." After 2 uses, swap back.
flavor: "...and there were seven minions on board, and it STILL hit the enemy hero!"

name: Supreme Dinomancy
text: Give +2/+2 to all Beasts in your hand, deck, and battlefield.
flavor: Not anyone can be a great dinomancer. But a great dinomancer can come from anywhere.

name: TREEEES!!!
text: Choose a minion. Summon four 2/2 Treants that attack it.
flavor: Photo synth THIS, fool!

name: Threshrider's Blessing
text: Give a friendly minion +4/+4 and "Deathrattle: Summon a random 4-Cost minion."
flavor: Blessed

name: Whispering Stone
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Get 2 random Fel spells. They cost Health instead of Mana.
flavor: shhhhhh...

name: Bonechill Stegodon
text: Deathrattle: Deal 6 damage to three random enemies.
flavor: Cold blooded. Bad to the bone. Needs a sweater.

name: City Chief Esho
text: Battlecry: If every minion in your deck shares a minion type, give your other minions +2/+2 (wherever they are).
flavor: "Let me esho you around!"

name: Deathrot Maw
text: Taunt Deathrattle: Summon a random Fel Beast.
flavor: Oh, don't worry, Deathy doesn't bite.

name: Gladesong Siren
text: Lifesteal Costs (1) if you've cast a Holy and Shadow spell this turn.
flavor: When she shifts into minor key she really throws the void-holy balance out of whack.

name: Nablya, the Watcher
text: Battlecry: Summon copies of your damaged minions. Give the copies Rush.
flavor: Of course the Titans trust the Tortollans to take care of Un'Goro Crater. Nablya is just there as insurance.

name: Opu the Unseen
text: Stealth. Battlecry, Combo, and Deathrattle: Cast 'Fan of Knives'.
flavor: This is allegedly what Opu looks like. We will confirm if we ever see him.

name: Pterrorwing Ravager
text: Rush Kindred: Costs (2) less.
flavor: Turns out most things are skyscreamers if you drop them from high enough.

name: Resuscitate
text: Resurrect a 1, 2, and 3-Cost minion. Give them Reborn.
flavor: This mud bath really does make you feel reborn.

name: Scalehide Kodo
text: Battlecry: Destroy the lowest Attack enemy minion. Kindred: The highest Attack instead.
flavor: Little Eeep and his pal Stomp are off to see the wonders of Un'Goro. First stop, Underfel!

name: Sizzling Swarm
text: Deal 3 damage. Summon that many 2/1 Sizzling Cinders.
flavor: Can someone open a window? It's a little swarm in here!

name: Titanographer Osk
text: Gains a random Titan ability in your hand that changes each turn.
flavor: Look at this Titangraph.

name: Tyrannogill
text: Rush Deathrattle: Summon three 2/1 Murlocs. Give them each a random Bonus Effect.
flavor: There's something fishy about that dinosaur...

name: Underbrush Tracker
text: Rush Costs (1) less for each time you've shuffled cards into your deck.
flavor: An expert at tracking the elusive Adaptive Amalgam.

name: Ravenous Devilsaur
text: Battlecry: Destroy a minion. Kindred: Gain its stats.
artist: L. Lullabi & I. Campelo da Silva
flavor: You're not you when you're ravenous.

name: Relic of Kings
text: Discover a spell from any class that costs (8) or more. It costs (1).
flavor: "Whoa, found a big plate!"

name: Story of Lakkari
text: At the end of your turn, discard a card and fill your board with 3/2 Imps. Lasts 3 turns.
flavor: Wow, the Tortollans really embellish these stories.

name: Wilted Shadow
text: Lifesteal Whenever you heal an enemy, this attacks it.
flavor: The shadow shall burn you!

name: Entomologist Toru
text: Battlecry: Put each minion in your hand into 0/1 Jars that cost (1). Break them to release the minions!
flavor: The lid. The lid. The lid. The lid. The lid. The lid.

name: High Cultist Herenn
text: Battlecry: Summon two Deathrattle minions from your deck. They fight!
flavor: "Hello." - Cultist Herenn

name: Tar Tyrant
text: Taunt, Lifesteal Has +6 Attack during your opponent's turn.
flavor: Why would they put a waterfall here if there wasn't something cool behind it?

name: Windpeak Wyrm
text: Battlecry: Deal 5 damage and gain 5 Armor. Kindred: Costs (3) less.
flavor: He's so anxious. Always winds up in knots.

name: Krog, Crater King
text: At the end of your turn, set the Attack and Health of all enemy minions to 1.
flavor: Who died and made him King of anything?

name: Loh, the Living Legend
text: Battlecry: Your minions cost (5) this game.
flavor: Pretty spry for a 4217 year old.

name: Whirling Stormdrake
text: Rush, Windfury Kindred: Gain Immune this turn.
flavor: Summons storms. Breathes fire. But first, does a sick loop-de-loop.

name: Story of Amara
text: Set your hero's Health to 40.
flavor: "Once upon a time... ok how about we just skip to the end?"

name: Ultragigasaur
flavor: Ultrasaur for scale.

name: Staff of the Endbringer
text: Deathrattle: Destroy all minions.
flavor: Finally, the loot I wanted off the boss! Too bad I'm on an alt...

name: Raptor-Nest Nurse
text: Battlecry: Get a random 1-Cost minion. Deathrattle: Get a random 1-Cost spell.
flavor: Spectacular, give me 14 of them right now.

name: Soulrest Ceremony
text: Give your minions +1 Attack and Rush. They die at the end of your turn.
flavor: When you're looking for lethal, you might have to break a few eggs.

name: Tortotem
text: At the end of your turn, get a random minion with multiple minion types.
flavor: If you tip it over, you're cursed with 7 years of bad luck.

name: Crystal Tusk
text: Battlecry: Shuffle the left- most card in your hand into your deck. Deathrattle: Draw 2 cards.
flavor: I stopped watching after the third film. You said this one's about aliens?

name: Firegill

name: Seismopod

name: Quel'dorei Fletcher

name: Waveshaping

name: Divergence

name: Doomsday Prepper
text: Outcast: Your hero is Immune until your next turn.
